summary: This article argues that instruction-fine-tuned language models should be understood as implementing a genre, what is proposed as the instructional-conversational genre. This genre is an amalgamation of discursive language from prior conversations between generative models and humans recursively run through these massive neural networks. It is instantiated in applications through instruction fine-tuning, the inclusion of a pretext known as a system prompt, and the formalization of inputs in mark-up languages characterized by the use of special tokens and role assignment in turntaking structures.
title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
title_translated: 指令的语言：体裁与生成式AI
summary_translated: 本文认为，经过指令微调的语言模型应被理解为实现了一种体裁，即所提出的“教学对话体裁”。这种体裁是生成式模型与人类之间先前对话的论述性语言，通过大规模神经网络递归运行而形成。它在应用中通过指令微调、包含称为系统提示的预设文本，以及使用特殊标记和角色分配机制的形式化输入（如标记语言）来具体体现。

summary: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were written by the system itself. We present Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent in daily use, and a measurement protocol (stratified sampling, frozen snapshots, thread-grouped splits, pre-registered hypotheses, human labels in the agent's review loop) that yields ground truth before any training. On 739 real Italian/English emails labelled by the owner (231 unbiased, 500 adversarially sampled), we compare nine systems under thread-grouped cross-validation: the production keyword rules, a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline, local typed decision models (Tev1, Nimble), a hosted decision model (Nimble v4-max), and hosted generative LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma 4 26B/31B). Four results. The production rules score 28% on message type against a 58% majority class: the field shown most prominently carried no information. With ~200 labels, logistic regression has the highest accuracy on every field (type 0.79, urgency 0.74, needs-reply 0.83, is-noise 0.90), though it never predicts the two rarest classes and is statistically tied with Gemma 4 on type; few-shot prompting does not close the gap. The sender's relationship (client, supplier, service) is recovered from other emails of the same contact with 98.6% accuracy where the contact has been seen, and is not inferable from a single message by any model: it belongs in the contact graph, not the prompt. Finally, accuracy is not the product metric: composed into actions, the most accurate system most often ignores emails needing action (18% vs 4% for the best LLM); a cost-chosen threshold on its noise probability halves that rate and makes it the cheapest system.
title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox

title_translated: 训练前先测量：类型化决策模型 vs. 经典基线 vs. 生成式大模型在个人多语言邮箱路由中的比较
summary_translated: 个人电子邮件代理需对每封邮件判断其类型、是否紧急、是否需要回复、创建任务或忽略。然而，其错误率很少被准确衡量，因为标注数据由系统自身生成。我们提出Foyer，一个日常使用的自托管个人邮箱代理，以及一套测量协议（分层抽样、冻结快照、线程分组划分、预先注册假设、在代理审查循环中的人工标注），可在任何训练前获得真实标签。在739封由所有者标注的真实意大利语/英语邮件（231个无偏样本，500个对抗性采样）上，我们采用线程分组交叉验证比较了九个系统：生产关键词规则、TF-IDF + 逻辑回归基线、本地类型化决策模型（Tev1, Nimble）、托管决策模型（Nimble v4-max）以及托管生成式大模型（Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma 4 26B/31B）。四项主要发现：生产规则在消息类型识别上仅得28%，远低于58%的多数类基准，表明最显著字段并无信息量；约200个标注下，逻辑回归在所有字段上表现最佳（类型0.79，紧急性0.74，需回复0.83，噪声0.90），但从未预测两个最罕见类别，且在类型任务上与Gemma 4统计上无差异；发送方关系（客户、供应商、服务）可通过同一联系人其他邮件以98.6%准确率恢复，单条消息无法推断，该信息属于联系人图谱而非提示内容；最终，准确率并非唯一指标：将最准确系统组合成动作后，其最常忽略需处理的邮件（18% vs 最佳LLM的4%）；通过成本选择阈值降低其噪声概率，可使该系统成为最经济方案。

summary: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. We present Yalda Embedding, a 595.8-million-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using more than one million query-document pairs. On eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB, the model achieves the highest macro-average among the evaluated 0.6B models, scoring 0.5488 and outperforming Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and F2LLM-v2-0.6B on every task. It also approaches Qwen3-Embedding-4B, winning on four tasks, tying on one, and trailing by 0.0075 in macro-average. An incremental ablation study examines contrastive batch size, optimization stabilization, and relational knowledge distillation from F2LLM-v2-8B. Under the one-epoch training setup, contrastive fine-tuning alone yields a modest mean improvement over initialization and regressions on two tasks. The final distilled configuration improves all eight tasks over the non-distilled model, raising the mean from 0.4813 to 0.5488 without increasing inference-time model size. These gains include hard-negative evaluation tasks despite training without explicitly mined or supplied hard negatives. We release model weights, training and evaluation code, the pairwise dataset, and its teacher-embedded counterpart, enabling inspection of data composition and training procedures, independent evaluation, and reuse without repeating expensive teacher inference.
title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
title_translated: Yalda-Embedding：一个竞争性波斯语检索模型的开放开发
summary_translated: 尽管多语言文本表示取得进展，但波斯语的有效密集检索仍受限于特定语言训练资源稀缺及紧凑嵌入模型的不足。我们提出Yalda Embedding，一个基于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B、使用超过一百万条查询-文档对微调的5.958亿参数波斯语检索模型。在FaMTEB的八个波斯语检索任务中，该模型在评估的0.6B模型中达到最高宏平均得分（0.5488），在每个任务上均优于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B和F2LLM-v2-0.6B，并接近Qwen3-Embedding-4B，在四个任务中胜出，一项持平，宏平均仅落后0.0075。增量消融研究分析了对比批次大小、优化稳定性以及来自F2LLM-v2-8B的关系知识蒸馏效果。在单轮训练设置下，仅对比微调带来适度平均提升，且在两项任务上出现退化；最终蒸馏配置在全部八项任务上优于非蒸馏模型，平均得分从0.4813提升至0.5488，且未增加推理时模型规模。这些提升包括硬负例评估任务，尽管训练中未显式挖掘或提供硬负例。我们公开了模型权重、训练与评估代码、成对数据集及其教师嵌入版本，支持数据组成与训练过程的可检查性、独立评估及无需重复昂贵教师推理的复用。

summary: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. This design is inherently limited, as many meaningful concepts---including multiword expressions and the structured environments of formal languages like LaTeX---frequently span across whitespaces. While recent superword tokenization methods attempt to address this by relaxing whitespace constraints, they often rely on greedy frequency-driven merging that fails to account for token length or the specific needs of underrepresented domain-specific languages. In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding (AdaBPE), a new tokenization method that leverages an adaptive frequent-pattern mining approach. AdaBPE features a twofold dynamicity: it adapts minimum frequency thresholds based on both the length of a candidate token, to prevent favoring frequent short patterns, and its type, to distinguish between general and formal language patterns, using LaTeX as case in point. This allows the model to efficiently allocate vocabulary capacity to domain-specific notations, such as LaTeX, even when they represent a small fraction of the training data. We evaluate AdaBPE across five datasets spanning LaTeX and natural language, showing consistent gains in encoding efficiency and downstream language-model performance on domain-specific content without compromising general-language performance.
title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
title_translated: 面向自然语言与结构符号混合语料的自适应频率阈值字节对编码
summary_translated: 现代语言模型依赖子词分词法定义输入处理的离散单元，通常采用字节对编码（BPE）方法，将空格视为固定的语义边界。这一设计存在固有局限，因为许多有意义的概念——包括多词表达以及LaTeX等形式语言的结构化环境——常常跨越空格。尽管近期的超词分词方法尝试通过放宽空格约束来解决此问题，但往往依赖贪婪的频率驱动合并策略，未能考虑词元长度或特定领域语言的特殊需求。本文提出自适应频率阈值字节对编码（AdaBPE），一种新的分词方法，利用自适应频繁模式挖掘技术。AdaBPE具有双重动态性：根据候选词长度自适应调整最小频率阈值，以避免偏好高频短模式；同时根据词元类型自适应区分通用语言与正式语言模式（以LaTeX为例）。这使得模型能高效地将词汇容量分配给特定领域符号（如LaTeX），即使它们在训练数据中占比极小。我们在涵盖LaTeX与自然语言的五个数据集上评估AdaBPE，结果显示其在编码效率和下游语言模型性能方面均有持续提升，且不影响通用语言表现。

summary: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.
title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
title_translated: J-Comm：基于雅可比引导的LLM智能体间潜在通信
summary_translated: 潜在通信需要有效的连续推理过程以及外部模型可利用其中间计算的接口。我们提出J-Comm框架，包含两个核心组件。首先，无需训练的几何一致性潜在推理（GEAR）重新加权现有模型嵌入中的词元候选，单调优化每一步嵌入空间中候选词元之间的几何共识。其次，我们引入H+J（隐藏与雅可比）通信接口，使接收方获得发送方推理的两种互补视角。H通道提供源自反馈分布的连续输入，J通道则以词汇索引雅可比透镜坐标传递中间状态线索。直观上，H为接收方提供推理输入，J在其计算中提供额外指导。接收方使用自身词典重建这些线索，并在预填充阶段注入中间层，实现通信而不共享键值缓存或要求模型宽度一致。在Qwen3-8B到Qwen3-4B的通信中，J-Comm在七个基准测试中取得最高平均得分，包括MATH500的94.80%、GPQA-Diamond的54.55%、AIME2024+2025的73.33%，以及ALFWorld的62.93%成功率。相比TextMAS，性能提升1.29-8.59个百分点，生成文本token减少19.2-74.8%。

summary: It is essential that we communicate with the entirety of an affected population during a crisis, including those who do not speak a region's dominant language(s). Commercial Translation tools offer a tempting solution to broaden access and can provide a lifeline when no other resources are available. However, Emergency response managers often operate in the dark regarding the quality and adequacy of these automated outputs. In this paper, we conduct a nationwide survey of emergency managers to understand their current workflows, perspectives, and operational challenges. We then evaluate commercial translation tools against these needs, shedding light on their utility and offering practical guidance on how and when these tools can be safely used in emergency response.
title: Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings

title_translated: 面向全体人群的沟通：紧急警报与警告的机器翻译
summary_translated: 在危机期间，向受影响人群的全体成员进行沟通至关重要，包括那些不使用当地主导语言的人。商业翻译工具提供了一种吸引人的解决方案，可以扩大访问范围，在其他资源不可用时成为救命稻草。然而，应急管理人员往往对这些自动化输出的质量和充分性缺乏了解。本文通过对全国范围内的应急管理人员进行调查，了解其当前的工作流程、观点和操作挑战。随后，我们根据这些需求评估了商业翻译工具的适用性，揭示了它们的实际效用，并提供了关于如何以及何时在应急响应中安全使用这些工具的实用建议。

summary: For agricultural advisory, generating an answer is only part of the problem: the system must also control unsafe requests, work with limited connectivity, and accommodate changing guidance. KRISHOKTECH is a Bengali agricultural advisory system built around an explicit authorization boundary around generation. Before retrieval, normalization and rule-based admission checks refer policy-covered high-risk requests and ask for a crop when treatment intent is underspecified. The system then binds retrieval to a single crop and asks for confirmation when the text and image indicate different crops. After generation, a narrow verifier removes dosage claims not supported by retrieved BARI/BRRI evidence. Agricultural guidance is kept in an external evidence index that can be updated without retraining the generator, while browser-side vision and local retrieval reduce connectivity requirements. The interface makes these decisions visible as ASK, CONFIRM, REFER, and DROP, together with their evidence. On 200 farmer queries and 400 stress queries, the controls halted underspecified requests and reduced cross-crop retrieval violations from 36.5% to 0% under the tested alias filter. Mismatch detection caught 453 of 454 text-image conflicts, while the verifier caught 114 of 118 inserted dosage errors. The demonstration shows how these controls govern the path from request to delivered advice.
title: KrishokTech: A Bengali Agricultural Advisory System with Explicit Authorization Controls
title_translated: KrishokTech：一个具有显式授权控制的孟加拉语农业咨询系统
summary_translated: 在农业咨询中，生成答案只是问题的一部分：系统还必须控制不安全请求、适应有限的网络连接，并应对不断变化的指导方针。KRISHOKTECH 是一个围绕生成过程构建显式授权边界的孟加拉语农业咨询系统。在检索之前，通过规范化和基于规则的准入检查识别出政策覆盖的高风险请求，并在治疗意图不明确时要求指定作物。系统随后将检索绑定到单一作物，并在文本与图像指示不同作物时请求确认。生成后，一个狭义验证器会移除未被检索到的 BARI/BRRI 证据支持的剂量声明。农业指导信息存储在外部证据索引中，可无需重新训练生成器即可更新，而浏览器端视觉处理和本地检索则降低了对网络连接的要求。界面以 ASK、CONFIRM、REFER 和 DROP 等形式展示这些决策及其证据。在 200 个农民查询和 400 个压力测试查询中，该系统阻止了不明确的请求，使跨作物检索违规率从 36.5% 降至 0%（在测试别名过滤条件下）。错配检测捕获了 453/454 个文本-图像冲突，验证器捕获了 114/118 个插入的剂量错误。演示展示了这些控制如何规范从请求到交付建议的全过程。

summary: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.
title: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
title_translated: Frontier-OPD：发现智能体能力的边界并教会智能体超越自身
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏将教师反馈与学生的当前行为对齐，但为多轮智能体获取有效监督需要同时识别出指导需求所在位置以及学生是否能在后续持续互动。我们提出 Frontier-OPD，通过学生的“学习前沿”解决这一问题：即那些仍具挑战性但经过短暂教师指导后可实现有用自主延续的决策情境。为了实现这一前沿，Frontier-OPD 将在线策略经验组织成共享状态轨迹图，通过教师-学生分歧的轨迹平衡聚合来识别不同的干预候选，同时保留用于重放的历史记录。随后，通过比较教师桥接段与后续学生延续段的共识，以及与原始轨迹等长段的共识，评估短教师桥接，从而提供一种行为代理，表明当前学生能够在此基础上建立。被接受的教师响应被纳入常规蒸馏数据，而新的滚动回放则随着策略变化更新前沿估计。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上的实验表明，相较于对比的蒸馏基线，Frontier-OPD 在所评估的学生规模和教师配置下均实现了更高的平均自主性能，消融实验也表明候选选择与指导过滤具有互补作用。在 ALFWorld 的某一时间设置中，额外的数据收集成本被达到目标成功率所需时间的缩短所抵消。

summary: Over the past fifteen years, digital tools for parallelizing and aligning textual corpora have developed significantly within the field of digital humanities. Several projects and software tools have been created to compare different translations or versions of texts. Despite these technical advances, many parallel corpora produced in academic contexts quickly become inaccessible online due to the lack of maintenance or funding. To address this gap, we present a suite of open-source tools developed within the ACR Grimm Tradalign and ParaTaxe projects. This suite includes the AIlign aligner, based on multilingual embeddings, a Python processing pipeline for converting and aligning corpora, a web interface called ParaTaxe for managing collections of parallel corpora, and a web interface for exploring aligned corpora built with TEI-Publisher.
title: ParaTaxe: a Suite of Tools for Processing and Publishing Multi-parallel Corpora
title_translated: ParaTaxe：一套用于处理与发布多语言平行语料库的工具集
summary_translated: 过去十五年来，数字人文领域在文本语料库的平行化与对齐方面取得了显著进展。多个项目和软件工具被开发出来，用于比较不同文本的翻译或版本。尽管技术进步显著，许多学术背景下产生的平行语料库仍因缺乏维护或资金支持而很快变得无法在线获取。为填补这一空白，我们介绍了在 ACR Grimm Tradalign 和 ParaTaxe 项目中开发的一套开源工具。该工具集包括基于多语言嵌入的 AIlign 对齐器、用于转换和对齐语料库的 Python 处理流水线、用于管理平行语料库集合的网页界面 ParaTaxe，以及基于 TEI-Publisher 构建的用于探索对齐语料库的网页界面。

summary: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.
title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents

title_translated: 每条边都需要引用：基于语言模型智能体构建医疗软件采纳的引用锚定知识图谱
summary_translated: 医院经常购买临床医生和患者依赖的软件。由于这些采购成本高昂、难以逆转且可能影响患者护理，买家会寻找同行机构已使用某产品的证据，以及该系统与其他系统的连接情况。这些证据虽公开，但分散在供应商网站、新闻稿和第三方页面中。如今，语言模型智能体可低成本地收集这些信息，但提取出的声明正确性难以验证，错误列出的客户可能会误导买家并歪曲组织形象。我们提出一个管道，从开放网络构建客户与集成关系的知识图谱，遵循一条规则：每条边都必须由其来源页面的原文引用支持。数据来自对每个供应商网站的确定性爬取，以及预算受限的 ReAct 智能体对网络其余部分的搜索。一个宽松的提取器提出带有引用的关系，分层接地阶段决定保留哪些关系，采用指称步骤（当引用仅提及一方时读取整页）、确定性检查，以及由五个模型调用组成的评审小组对九项标准进行投票。在 61 个供应商上，该管道在 6,428 个候选关系中达到 0.94 的精确率和 0.71 的召回率（提取器的判断由一个模型起草，经第二个模型复核）。与黄金参考（市场自身的精选列表）相比，其得分较低，但其保留的、参考中缺失的关系中有 89% 在页面上有明确陈述。基于评审小组投票构建的置信度分数，在相同精确率下比固定规则保留更多正确关系，且在 0.90 精确率下达到 0.90 召回率。我们还讨论了窄域、有界模型调用、字符串匹配证据和投票机制如何缓解长上下文退化和运行间波动问题。

summary: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.
title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
title_translated: 基于策略的自训练：大语言模型的无数据自提升
summary_translated: 基于策略的自蒸馏使基础模型在无需依赖更强外部教师的情况下实现后训练。然而，现有方法依赖于真实的问题-答案对、人工整理的问题集或其他监督信号。本文将基于策略的自蒸馏重新构想为一种自训练框架，由自生成的问题-答案对和特权推理示范驱动。我们最大限度地施加监督：仅根据粗略的高层次主题描述，模型在不访问任何人工整理提示或答案的情况下，自主合成查询课程和特权推理轨迹。我们发现，基于完全合成的特权信息进行自蒸馏，可使模型在多个领域实现性能提升，同时保留其在未自训练领域的原有能力。我们在文本和多模态领域均验证了该框架的通用性，在标准语言基准和视觉问答任务中实现了持续的自我改进。研究结果表明，基础模型具备丰富的潜在能力，可在无需外部任务监督或精心设计问题分布的情况下被放大。

summary: The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts. To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction. Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking. First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers. Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology. By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable. In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen's $\kappa$ scores of 0.640--0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human--human agreement range of 0.616--0.689. We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96\% are judged correct. The pipeline code and KG is publicly available this https URL .
title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
title_translated: 基于本体引导的结构化元数据与气候科学文献知识图谱构建
summary_translated: 科学文献的快速扩张远超人工整理的速度，导致从科学文本中提取结构化知识成为根本瓶颈。为此，我们提出一种代理式、本体引导的知识图谱（KG）构建框架。该框架利用专门的智能体完成文档理解、信息抽取、本体一致性校验和实体链接。首先，大语言模型从科研论文中提取带有明确文本证据的事实三元组；随后，三元组经过多阶段验证过程，以确保其符合本体规范。通过强制执行模式约束并要求以文本片段形式提供证据，我们保证数据在语义上一致且可追溯。在对1000个提取三元组的协议研究中，Gemini-2.5-flash与三位人工标注者达成的Cohen's κ系数为0.640–0.700，处于人与人之间协议范围（0.616–0.689）内。我们将该框架应用于2000篇科学出版物，构建了一个包含133,990个节点和755,308条关系的新型气候科学本体引导知识图谱；经验证后，23,327个三元组中有98.96%被判定为正确。该流程代码和知识图谱已公开发布。

summary: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker's underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness. We propose CounselPlex, a stressor-aware full-duplex framework that uses two operations. CounselPlex updates a short stressor state during seeker silence and injects this state into <PAD> positions while listening. We also introduce RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA), which broadens positional coverage during training and improves performance at longer turn depths in our evaluation. LLM-judge evaluations show improved counseling quality and stressor grounding over strong baselines.
title: CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model
title_translated: CounselPlex：一种压力源感知的全双工咨询模型
summary_translated: 全双工语音模型能够同时听和说，实现自然、低延迟的交互。但在咨询场景中，这些模型往往只关注最新话语，而忽视来访者潜在的核心问题。我们称这种缺陷为“压力源盲视”。我们提出CounselPlex，一种压力源感知的全双工框架，采用两种操作：在来访者沉默期间更新短期压力源状态，并在监听时将该状态注入<PAD>位置。我们还引入RoPE位置偏移增强（RPSA），在训练中扩大位置覆盖范围，提升了在更长对话深度下的表现。LLM评判评估显示，相比强基线，CounselPlex在咨询质量和压力源关联性方面均有显著提升。

summary: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) express a model's internal activations in the form of readable text. The verbalizer turns an activation into an English explanation; the reconstructor then converts that explanation back into an activation, and the explanation is considered successful if the round trip brings back the original activation. We claim that this criterion evaluates whether the information is sufficient and does not address descriptive faithfulness. A sentence can contain sufficient information to make it possible to identify an activation even if it wrongly explains what the activation does: in the case of reconstruction, the primary aim is to accurately identify the activations and not to describe them. This issue has the same structure as the chain-of-thought faithfulness problem, in which verbal output that has been trained to go with a process is taken as a report on that process, and it parallels the dissociation between an individual's introspective report and the actual governing process as documented in human psychology. Although proposed as interpretability tools for the purpose of alignment, NLAs reintroduce, through unverified explanations, the epistemic problem that they were intended to resolve.
title: Natural Language Autoencoders Identify Without Explaining
title_translated: 自然语言自编码器能识别但无法解释
summary_translated: 自然语言自编码器（NLAs）以可读文本的形式表达模型内部激活状态。其中，表述器将激活转换为英文解释，重构器再将该解释还原为激活，若往返恢复原始激活，则认为解释成功。我们认为这一标准衡量的是信息充分性，而非描述忠实性。一个句子即使错误解释了激活的作用，只要包含足够信息以识别该激活，仍可被视为成功重建——在重建任务中，首要目标是准确识别激活，而非描述其功能。这一问题与思维链忠实性问题具有相同结构：训练中与过程匹配的表述被当作对该过程的报告，这类似于人类心理学中个体内省报告与实际支配过程之间的分离。尽管NLA被提出作为对齐的可解释性工具，但它们通过未经验证的解释重新引入了原本旨在解决的认知论难题。

summary: Quality-Aware Decoding (QAD) improves machine translation through test-time scaling, generating multiple candidate translations and selecting the final output with a quality-aware decoder. Usually the same candidate budget N is spent on every source sentence, assuming that all inputs require the same amount of search. We show that this assumption does not hold and that the quality gain obtained from additional candidates varies across sentences. We study search utility through three quantities: total scaling gain, how much quality a sentence can gain from a much larger candidate pool; marginal scaling gain, the expected gain from generating one additional batch of candidates; and the sampling saturation point, the candidate budget required to realize most of the total scaling gain. We investigate two sources of information for predicting these quantities: signals available before candidate-set expansion, and statistics computed from the candidate pool accumulated during search. We find that sentence-level signals correlate with total scaling gain but are less informative about the sampling saturation point. In contrast, properties of the current candidate pool provide useful signals of marginal scaling gain. Finally, we show that these signals can identify sentences that obtain larger gains when additional search is selectively applied.
title: When is more search useful? An Empirical Study of Search Utility in Quality-Aware Decoding for Machine Translation
title_translated: 何时搜索更有用？面向质量感知解码的机器翻译中搜索效用实证研究
summary_translated: 质量感知解码（QAD）通过测试时扩展提升机器翻译性能，生成多个候选翻译并使用质量感知解码器选择最终输出。通常对每个源句都分配相同的候选预算N，假设所有输入所需的搜索量相同。我们证明这一假设并不成立，额外候选带来的质量提升在不同句子间存在差异。我们通过三个指标研究搜索效用：总扩展增益（单句从更大候选池中获得的质量提升）、边际扩展增益（生成一组新候选的预期收益）以及采样饱和点（实现大部分总增益所需的候选预算）。我们考察两类预测信号：候选集扩展前可用的信息，以及搜索过程中累积候选池的统计特征。结果表明，句子级信号与总扩展增益相关，但对采样饱和点预测能力较弱；而当前候选池的属性则能有效预测边际扩展增益。最后，我们证明这些信号可用于识别在选择性增加搜索时能获得更大收益的句子。

summary: Fine-tuning the non-blank predictor of a factorized transducer on target-domain text improves recognition on that domain but degrades performance on the source domain. A single interpolation weight between base and adapted predictors cannot resolve this: the adapted predictor helps at some prefixes and hurts at others, often within one utterance. We propose conservative residual routing: the adapted predictor becomes a residual correction to the base, and a 16k-parameter gate decides at each prefix how much of it to admit. Closing the gate reproduces the base exactly. On a 40-hour conversational corpus, routing retains essentially all of the text-only gain on two held-out domains (19.89 to 16.74, 20.91 to 16.21 WER) while leaving source-domain WER unchanged (12.90 to 12.93); the adapted predictor alone costs 1.08 WER. Routing needs no per-domain tuning on target-domain audio. Analysis reveals the gate does not behave as a simple domain-level switch: it modulates intervention through the disagreement between the two predictors, suppressing it in-domain and amplifying it out-of-domain.
title: Residual Expert Routing for Text-Only Domain Adaptation of Factorized Transducer ASR
title_translated: 基于残差专家路由的分块变换器文本域自适应
summary_translated: 在目标域文本上微调分块变换器的非空白预测器可提升该域的识别性能，但会降低源域表现。单一的基线与适配预测器之间的插值权重无法解决此问题：适配预测器在某些前缀上有所帮助，而在其他前缀上则造成损害，甚至在同一语音段内交替出现。我们提出保守的残差路由机制：将适配预测器作为基线的残差修正，并通过一个16k参数的门控单元决定每个前缀应采纳多少适配信息。关闭门控可完全复现基线模型。在40小时对话语料上，该方法在两个保留域中几乎保留了全部仅文本域带来的增益（WER从19.89降至16.74，20.91降至16.21），同时保持源域WER不变（12.90至12.93）；而单独使用适配预测器则导致1.08 WER的损失。该路由机制无需针对目标域音频进行每域调优。分析表明，门控并非简单的域级开关，而是通过两个预测器之间的分歧程度调节干预强度，在域内抑制干预，在域外增强干预。

summary: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.
title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
title_translated: PHYRD：用于重现与拓展理论物理研究的动态基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型和智能体在高级物理研究中展现出显著能力。本文介绍PHYRD，一个面向理论物理推理的动态基准测试，包含63个可重现问题和43个可发现性问题。可重现问题用于测试对已发表结果的推导能力；可发现性问题则用于检验修改理论条件后的推论结果。FormulaForest利用参考解答和子问题级别的评分标准构建任务。在五个模型中，整体问题准确率在可重现任务上为49.21%至68.25%，在闭卷可发现任务上为18.60%至74.42%。使用工具后，四个模型完成更多可发现性问题，但概念错误和论证缺失仍存在。此外，实验结果表明FormulaForest作为合成数据具有价值：在OpenAI开发的FrontierScience基准上，它将Qwen-35B-A3B模型的准确率从61%提升至72%。

summary: Adapting ASR to a domain with only untranscribed audio typically relies on pseudo-labeling, a strong teacher transcribes the audio and a student is fine-tuned on it. Because supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats every pseudo-label token as a target, the student inherits the teacher's errors. We show that using the same pseudo-labels as a reward reference for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is more robust to label noise. In the banking domain, GRPO yields 29.3% to 56.2% relative WER improvements over SFT on Whisper-generated labels, and the advantage holds across four Whisper sizes, four teacher families, three domains and four languages. While SFT reproduces almost 100% of teacher errors verbatim, GRPO passes through only 27%. Rollout statistics explain why, erroneous pseudo-label words rarely appear in on-policy rollouts, so group-relative advantages stay aligned with the clean transcript, whereas SFT forces them into the policy's support and collapses the reward variance GRPO relies on.
title: Pseudo-Labels as Rewards, Not Targets: Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Semi-Supervised ASR
title_translated: 伪标签作为奖励而非目标：面向半监督ASR的组相对策略优化
summary_translated: 在仅有未转录音频的情况下适应ASR系统通常依赖伪标签技术：由强教师模型转录音频，学生模型在此基础上进行微调。由于监督微调（SFT）将每个伪标签词元视为目标，学生会继承教师的错误。我们证明，将相同的伪标签用作组相对策略优化（GRPO）的奖励参考，能更有效地应对标签噪声。在银行领域，GRPO相较于SFT在Whisper生成的伪标签上实现了29.3%至56.2%的相对WER改进，且该优势在四种Whisper模型大小、四类教师模型家族、三个领域和四种语言中均成立。SFT几乎原样复制了近100%的教师错误，而GRPO仅传递了27%。滚动统计分析揭示原因：错误的伪标签词很少出现在策略内的滚动路径中，因此组相对优势仍与干净转录对齐；而SFT强制这些错误进入策略支持集，导致GRPO所依赖的奖励方差崩溃。

summary: This paper examines speech characteristics of the Austrian National Council members (CMs). We introduce analysis methodology based on a fine-tuned BERT-Model which assigns to every speech a probability distribution over Austrian parties. These are then aggregated at the speaker and party level. We perform an extensive evaluation to ensure the quality of the generated distributions prior to further analysis. Instead of considering mis-assignments of predicted parties as a performance issue, we leverage them to derive insights about the CMs and political developments. Our findings show that parties that govern together become more similar in their speech characteristics, while, analogously, parties that are in opposition move further away from governing parties. Moreover, CMs who switch party usually adapt their speech characteristics only after the switch occurs. Finally, we publicly release a data set containing party affiliation predictions for the speeches of the Austrian National Council from 1996 to 2018.
title: Analysing Austrian Parliamentary Speeches by Predicting Party Affiliations
title_translated: 通过预测政党归属分析奥地利议会演讲
summary_translated: 本文研究奥地利国民议会成员（CMs）的演讲特征。我们引入一种基于微调BERT模型的分析方法，为每篇演讲分配奥地利各政党的概率分布，并在发言人和政党层面进行聚合。我们进行了广泛评估以确保生成分布的质量，再进行后续分析。不同于将预测政党误判视为性能问题，我们将其转化为对议员及政治发展的洞察。研究发现，共同执政的政党在演讲特征上趋于相似，而对立政党则逐渐远离执政党。此外，政党转换者通常在换党之后才调整其演讲特征。最后，我们公开发布了1996年至2018年奥地利国民议会演讲的政党归属预测数据集。

summary: Resources for toxicity detection in Punjabi remain limited, particularly for musical content that combines linguistic and multimodal information. We present the Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG), a segment-level resource developed to support research on toxicity detection in Punjabi musical content. The dataset was constructed from publicly available Punjabi songs collected from YouTube. An initial collection of 620 songs resulted in 465 successfully downloaded songs and 3,402 preliminary segments from 450 songs. After quality control and annotation, the final dataset contains 2,396 unique segments from 392 songs. Four native Punjabi annotators produced 2,870 annotation records, including a shared subset of 158 segments annotated by all four. Each annotation includes binary toxicity, eight fine-grained toxicity categories, severity, sentiment, mode, and an uncertainty flag. Inter-annotator agreement was measured with Fleiss' kappa on the shared subset, and majority-based resolution produced the final segment-level labels. Of the 2,396 segments, 705 (29.42%) were labelled toxic and 1,691 (70.58%) non-toxic. Violence was the most frequent category, occurring in 539 toxic segments (76.45%), followed by gang references (227, 32.20%) and drug references (133, 18.87%). The overall toxicity label achieved substantial agreement (kappa = 0.6521). PGT-FG provides a fine-grained resource for Punjabi toxicity detection and multimodal content analysis. The resolved dataset, with one final record per segment, is publicly available on Zenodo ( this https URL ). Original lyrics, lyric excerpts, and copyrighted audio or video content are not redistributed.
title: The Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG): Fine-Grained Multimodal Annotations for Toxic Content in Punjabi Songs
title_translated: 旁遮普歌曲毒性数据集（PGT-FG）：旁遮普歌曲中毒性内容的细粒度多模态标注
summary_translated: 针对旁遮普语的毒性检测资源仍然有限，尤其缺乏结合语言与多模态信息的音乐内容研究支持。我们提出旁遮普歌曲毒性数据集（PGT-FG），一个面向段落级别的资源，旨在支持旁遮普语音乐内容中的毒性检测研究。该数据集源自从YouTube收集的公开旁遮普歌曲。初始采集620首歌曲，成功下载465首，共生成3,402个初步片段（来自450首歌曲）。经过质量控制与标注后，最终数据集包含392首歌曲中的2,396个唯一片段。四位母语旁遮普语标注员共生成2,870条标注记录，其中158个片段由所有四人共同标注。每条标注包括二分类毒性标签、八个细粒度毒性类别、严重程度、情感、表达方式及不确定性标志。通过Fleiss' kappa在共享子集上测量标注者间一致性，采用多数投票法确定最终段落级标签。在2,396个片段中，705个（29.42%）被标记为有毒，1,691个（70.58%）为无毒。暴力是最常见的类别，出现在539个有毒片段中（占76.45%），其次为黑帮提及（227，32.20%）和毒品提及（133，18.87%）。总体毒性标签达到实质性一致（kappa = 0.6521）。PGT-FG为旁遮普语毒性检测和多模态内容分析提供了细粒度资源。经处理的最终数据集（每片段一条记录）已公开发布于Zenodo（此链接）。原始歌词、歌词摘录以及受版权保护的音视频内容未重新分发。

summary: While large vision-language models excel at optical character recognition, it remains unclear how their underlying vision encoders process text and its meaning, and whether they support anything resembling reading comprehension. We systematically study transformer-based vision encoders, using cross-modal alignment between rendered text and visual concepts together with probing and retrieval-based analyses as a controlled window into these broader capabilities. Our layer-wise analyses span orthographic, grammatical, and semantic organization, and reveal that strong cross-modal mapping emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal object and text recognition have already developed, coinciding with a progression from surface-level to semantic representations. Although this hierarchy is strongest in contrastively trained models, larger self-supervised models and text-rich training data partially support similar behaviors without explicit language supervision. Together, our results suggest that increasing model and training-data scale, as well as text-rich training data, can partially compensate for the absence of language supervision.
title: Reading Between the Layers: Cross-Modal Alignment and Representational Hierarchy in Vision Transformers
title_translated: 层间阅读：视觉Transformer中的跨模态对齐与表征层次
summary_translated: 尽管大型视觉-语言模型在光学字符识别方面表现出色，但其底层视觉编码器如何处理文本及其语义仍不明确，且尚不清楚它们是否支持类似阅读理解的能力。我们系统性地研究了基于Transformer的视觉编码器，利用渲染文本与视觉概念之间的跨模态对齐，结合探针分析和检索分析，作为洞察其更广泛能力的可控窗口。我们的分层分析涵盖了拼写、语法和语义组织，结果表明强烈的跨模态映射仅在最深层出现，此时单模态物体和文本识别已基本完成，同时表征也从表层向语义层面演进。尽管这种层次结构在对比学习训练的模型中最强，但更大的自监督模型和富含文本的训练数据也能在没有显式语言监督的情况下部分支持类似行为。总体而言，我们的结果表明，增加模型规模、训练数据量以及使用富含文本的数据，可以在一定程度上弥补缺乏语言监督的不足。

summary: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial, a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. Experiments on coronary heart disease demonstrate that CoRPS-Dial improves alignment between synthetic and real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and dialogue naturalness. Downstream fine-tuning experiments further confirm the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for clinically grounded and controllable medical dialogue synthesis.
title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
title_translated: 解耦患者人格与临床流程：一种双智能体方法实现真实医疗对话生成
summary_translated: 问诊前的医疗对话对于全面收集患者信息至关重要，但由于隐私和伦理限制，大规模获取成本高昂。现有的基于大语言模型的合成方法通常依赖提示工程或固定规则，难以在临床相关性与患者多样性之间取得平衡。我们提出CoRPS-Dial，一种可控制的双智能体框架，用于问诊前医疗对话的合成，该框架将患者人格特征与符合指南的临床流程规则相结合。CoRPS-Dial通过一个以人格驱动的患者智能体与一个流程引导的医生智能体之间的交互生成对话，并随后进行事后质量控制，确保角色一致性、流程完整性与文本一致性。在冠心病场景下的实验表明，CoRPS-Dial在信息覆盖度、临床合规性和对话自然度方面显著提升了合成对话与真实对话的一致性。下游微调实验进一步证实了生成的合成数据在医疗对话任务中的实用性。这些结果凸显了CoRPS-Dial在临床基础且可控制的医疗对话合成中的有效性。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of supporting scientific workflows, but their capabilities across diverse research activities remain difficult to assess systematically. Existing benchmarks often focus on selected scientific capabilities or task types, limiting a comprehensive characterization of scientific agents' strengths and weaknesses in realistic research workflows. We introduce SCI-AGENT-EXAM, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types defined by the Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy (SWTT). Each task requires both executable artifacts (e.g., code and scripts) and textual artifacts (e.g., reports and explanations). To evaluate the heterogeneous task outputs, we develop a hybrid evaluation protocol combining deterministic programmatic verification for executable artifacts with a calibrated, expert-validated LLM-based judge for textual artifacts. Beyond outcome assessment, we analyze progress and solution stability along execution trajectories to characterize how agents reach their final results. Experiments with 10 frontier LLM agents reveal substantial performance gaps: GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest overall score of 80.9, yet only 26.0% of its runs exceed the 0.95 success threshold. Further analyses uncover distinct capability profiles across scientific task types and substantial variation in execution efficiency and stability. Our code and data are available at this https URL .
title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM: Benchmarking Agents on Scientific Research Tasks
title_translated: SCI-AGENT-EXAM：面向科学科研任务的智能体基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在支持科学工作流方面日益强大，但其在多样化科研活动中的能力仍难以系统评估。现有基准往往聚焦于特定科学能力或任务类型，限制了对科学智能体在真实科研工作流中优劣势的全面刻画。我们引入SCI-AGENT-EXAM，一个以工作流为导向的基准，包含11个科学领域和7种研究任务类型的120项专家精心设计的任务，依据科学工作流任务分类法（SWTT）定义。每项任务均需生成可执行的成果（如代码和脚本）和文本成果（如报告和解释）。为评估异构任务输出，我们开发了一种混合评估协议：对可执行成果采用确定性的程序化验证，对文本成果则使用经过校准的专家验证的LLM评分器。除了结果评估外，我们还分析执行轨迹中的进展与解决方案稳定性，以刻画智能体如何达成最终结果。对10个前沿LLM智能体的实验揭示了显著的性能差距：GPT-6 Astra取得最高总分为80.9，但仅有26.0%的运行超过0.95的成功阈值。进一步分析揭示了不同科学任务类型间的独特能力分布，以及执行效率与稳定性的显著差异。我们的代码和数据可在该链接获取。

summary: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles---demographics and Big Five personality traits---and business profiles---intents reverse-engineered from real call logs---enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with hierarchical rewards at the dialogue and utterance levels. Paired with a customer service agent integrating Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) constraints and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ProfileSim achieves the highest colloquial naturalness, the strongest user profile adherence and the lowest agent score on long-tail intents among all evaluated user generators, while producing substantially shorter user utterances at comparable business compliance. The generated dialogue data is designed to support intent recognition training, agent evaluation, and rapid cold-start deployment.
title: Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues
title_translated: 基于分层奖励强化学习的个性化用户模拟用于任务导向型对话
summary_translated: 构建高价值场景（如金融营销）中的任务导向型对话（TOD）系统需要大量领域特定的对话数据，但受隐私法规、标注成本及专家人力需求的限制，难以获取。用户模拟提供了一种解决方案，但现有方法主要针对通用领域对话，存在两个关键局限：对领域特定业务流程和合规约束建模不足，以及未能充分捕捉语音交互中口语化、非正式的语言特征。我们提出ProfileSim，一种面向金融营销外呼电话的个性化用户模拟框架。该框架联合建模用户画像（人口统计学特征与大五人格特质）和业务画像（从真实通话日志中逆向推导出的意图），从而实现对模拟行为的细粒度控制。基础模型在真实语音对话数据上进行微调，并通过分层奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行精炼，奖励机制涵盖对话级与话语级。与集成标准操作流程（SOP）约束和检索增强生成（RAG）的客服智能体配合，ProfileSim在口语自然度、用户画像遵循度方面表现最佳，长尾意图的智能体得分最低，同时生成的用户话语更短，且保持相当的业务合规性。生成的对话数据旨在支持意图识别训练、智能体评估及快速冷启动部署。

summary: LLM-based annotation has advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world practice. Actual annotation often involves lengthy, task-specific guidelines, and different annotators may produce divergent but reasonable judgments, especially on boundary cases, where single-labeled dataset fail to reflect this disagreement. This gap also limits existing single-agent and workflow-based annotation systems, which often lack adaptability to complex, evolving guidelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce ANT-A Benchmark, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark spanning 7 datasets across domains and modalities, with task-specific guidelines and 5 independent human labels per instance. ANT-A enables a distribution-aware evaluation, using Fleiss kappa to assess how closely model annotations align with human labeling distributions. We further propose ANT-OR, a multi-agent annotation framework that refines prompts by distilling contrastive decision rules from positive and negative feedback. Experiments show that ANT-OR improves agreement@>=2 accuracy by 4.5 points over the strongest baseline and achieves the highest alignment with human annotator distributions as measured by Fleiss kappa within 2 points. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL .
title: Can LLM Annotators Match Human Consistency? Benchmarking Human Agreement and Optimizing Multi-Agent with Contrastive Knowledge
title_translated: LLM标注者能否达到人类一致性？基准测试人类一致性并优化多智能体对比知识
summary_translated: 基于LLM的标注技术发展迅速，但现有基准仍与实际应用脱节。真实标注通常涉及冗长的任务特定指南，不同标注者在边界案例上可能产生合理但不同的判断，而单标签数据集无法反映这种分歧。这一差距也限制了现有单智能体和工作流式标注系统，它们往往难以适应复杂且不断演变的指南。为弥合这一差距，我们引入ANT-A基准，一个涵盖7个跨领域、跨模态数据集的真实世界多标注者基准，每个实例配有任务特定指南和5个独立的人类标签。ANT-A支持分布感知评估，使用Fleiss Kappa衡量模型标注与人类标注分布的接近程度。我们进一步提出ANT-OR，一种多智能体标注框架，通过从正负反馈中提炼对比决策规则来优化提示。实验表明，ANT-OR在≥2一致率上比最强基线提升4.5个百分点，并在Fleiss Kappa指标上与人类标注分布的对齐度达到2点以内，表现最优。代码与基准数据可在该链接获取。

summary: Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. In this paper, we ask whether this mechanism expands together with the input modalities of the model. Taking audio-visual input as a newly added modality, we construct paired inputs in which the same answer is either spoken or shown on screen. With the evidence content fixed, retrieval heads remain sparse in the new modality and are shared to a large extent across modalities. Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones. Ablating these heads eliminates nearly all audio-visual retrieval. The heads shared across modalities make up fewer than 2\% of all heads, yet ablating them also degrades document understanding, spatial perception, and visual mathematics. Building on these findings, we turn retrieval heads into a target of optimization by training their attention with a ranking objective. This raises the page Recall@1 of Qwen3-VL-8B on MMDocIR by 6.03 points and improves document retrieval across three model families. Functional attention heads can thus serve both as a lens on multimodal models and as a target for improving them.
title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
title_translated: 多模态大模型检索头的更广泛视角
summary_translated: 在长输入中定位相关证据是多模态大语言模型的核心能力。先前研究将这一能力归因于检索头——一组稀疏的注意力头，负责将上下文信息传递到输出。然而，这些分析局限于有限的模态和对应模型。此外，如何利用检索头提升模型性能仍需进一步探索。本文探讨该机制是否随模型输入模态的扩展而扩展。以音视频输入作为新增模态，我们构建了成对输入，其中相同答案通过语音或屏幕显示呈现。在证据内容固定的情况下，检索头在新模态中仍保持稀疏性，并在不同模态间高度共享。在18个语言、视觉-语言及全模态检查点中，全模态模型基本保留了其基础模型的检索头。移除这些头几乎完全破坏了音视频检索能力。跨模态共享的头不足所有头的2%，但移除它们也损害了文档理解、空间感知和视觉数学能力。基于这些发现，我们通过引入排序目标对检索头进行优化训练。这使得Qwen3-VL-8B在MMDocIR上的页面召回率@1提升了6.03点，并改善了三个模型家族的文档检索表现。因此，功能性的注意力头既可作为观察多模态模型的透镜，也可作为优化改进的目标。

summary: Spoken native language (L1) identification for second language learners has traditionally relied on acoustic attributes of speech. Comparatively little attention has been paid to analysing speech transcripts for L1 traces. In this paper, we present a study of L1 identification using both speech and corresponding transcripts from a spoken learner English corpus. We compare a WavLM-based audio L1 classifier with a zero-shot GPT-4o classifier operating on transcripts and analyse their predictions across proficiency levels using a CEFR-balanced evaluation set. Our experiments show that the audio classifier outperforms the transcript-based approach overall when full transcripts are available, although their relative strengths vary with learner proficiency. Audio performs better at A1, whereas text performs better from A2 to C1 with full transcripts. Transcript-based accuracy generally increases with proficiency, while acoustic performance remains comparatively stable. Restricting transcript length substantially reduces text-based accuracy, whereas audio is less sensitive to input length and performs relatively well with limited input. These findings provide insights into L1 identification from acoustic and textual representations of learner speech and how performance varies with proficiency and the amount of available language material.
title: Acoustic and Lexical Signals for Native Language Identification of Language Learners
title_translated: 学习者第二语言发音与词汇信号在母语识别中的应用
summary_translated: 传统上，第二语言学习者的口语母语（L1）识别主要依赖语音的声学特征。相比之下，对语音转录文本中L1痕迹的分析关注较少。本文研究了基于语音及其对应转录文本的L1识别方法，使用一个英语学习者口语语料库的数据。我们将基于WavLM的音频L1分类器与基于零样本GPT-4o的文本分类器进行比较，并在CEFR平衡评估集上分析不同语言水平下的预测表现。实验表明，当完整转录文本可用时，音频分类器整体表现优于文本方法，尽管两者相对优势随学习者水平变化。在A1水平，音频表现更优；而在A2至C1水平，文本表现更佳。文本识别准确率通常随语言水平提高而上升，而声学表现则相对稳定。限制转录长度会显著降低文本识别准确率，而音频对输入长度不敏感，在输入受限时仍表现良好。这些发现为从声学与文本表征角度理解学习者母语识别提供了洞见，并揭示了性能如何随语言水平和可用语言材料量而变化。

summary: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. For sliding-window models, we identify two contributing mechanisms. Gibberish and silence are linked to Initialization-Anchor Eviction, where the sliding window discards the first KV entry. Repetition is also reinforced by the model's own recent outputs. Guided by this diagnosis, we apply two simple fixes: Initialization-Anchor Pinning (IAP) keeps that first entry, and Duplex Repetition Penalty (DRP) discourages echoing while guarding against prolonged silence. Together, they support the diagnosis and, without retraining, substantially reduce conversational collapse in replays of up to an hour while running in real time.
title: Why Full-Duplex Speech Models Collapse in Long Conversations
title_translated: 全双工语音模型为何在长对话中崩溃
summary_translated: 全双工语音模型能够同时听和说，使其在自然、开放式的对话中具有潜力。但它们能否维持数十分钟的连贯对话？由于每帧生成一个token，即使在聆听时也在持续消耗上下文窗口，导致几分钟内即耗尽。然而，现有基准仅评估单轮或少数对话回合，不足以暴露长期问题。为此，我们提出全双工长时程基准（FD-LHB），测试五种近期全双工模型在长时间重播对话和与LLM伙伴实时对话中的表现。每个被评估模型最终均出现性能下降或上下文耗尽。保留完整历史的模型往往在上下文耗尽前就已退化，而滑动窗口模型则陷入重复、沉默和无意义内容。针对滑动窗口模型，我们识别出两个关键机制：无意义内容和沉默与‘初始化锚点驱逐’有关，即滑动窗口丢弃首个KV条目；重复现象也受到模型自身近期输出的强化。基于此诊断，我们提出两种简单修复方案：初始化锚点固定（IAP）保留首个条目，全双工重复惩罚（DRP）抑制回声并防止长时间沉默。二者结合后，无需重新训练即可显著减少长达一小时的重播对话中的对话崩溃现象，且支持实时运行。

summary: When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.
title: Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction

title_translated: 超越最终结果：量化多智能体LLM交互中的主张级信息动态
summary_translated: 当由LLM驱动的智能体相互作用时，信息被反复共享、扩展和遗忘，但多智能体评估通常只关注最终任务结果。我们研究这种交互为主张级信息动态，并提出RIVER方法，将智能体输出分解为原子主张，评估三个互补维度：收敛性、探索性和保留性。收敛性捕捉跨智能体主张的一致性与立场对齐；探索性衡量语义广度及对源信息的拓展；保留性追踪源信息的保真度以及新主张在各阶段和演化路径中的持久性。我们在40个受控新闻生成案例中评估五种交互策略。反复聚合式交互促进收敛性，但缩小了信息空间；分布式接力则产生更广泛但共享较少的信息。进一步对比显示，特定方法约束会增加探索性，但削弱收敛性和保留性。我们的发现表明，集体信息动态更应由底层信息流机制解释，而非简单的下游性能指标。

summary: System One models, or decision models, answer a question about an input with a calibrated probability instead of generated text. Within weeks of the first release, in September 2026, they were used as rerankers. We test whether the decision fine-tuning behind them makes a better reranker than plain reranker fine-tuning of the same model. For six Qwen backbones from 0.6B to 27B parameters and ten TREC DL and BEIR collections, we compare the untuned model, asked zero-shot, with its decision fine-tunes and its reranker fine-tunes, two of which we train ourselves. In our work, we draw the conclusion that decision fine-tuning never makes the better reranker. From 0.6B to 9B, reranker fine-tuning wins on every backbone by 5 to 29 points nDCG@10, also on zero-shot collections, and at 27B the two tie. Up to 9B, decision fine-tuning adds nothing over simply asking the untuned model. Moreover, we find that the calibration advantage of decision models depends on the question. Asked whether a passage answers the query, they are better calibrated than the published reranker fine-tunes from 4B on. Asked a slightly different question from prior work, they lose this advantage. Lastly, calibration does not make up for a worse ranking: up to 9B, a reranker fine-tune keeps the better passages at a fixed threshold. If you need a reranker, fine-tune a reranker.
title: System One models Are Not Better Rerankers
title_translated: 系统一模型并非更优的重排序器
summary_translated: 系统一模型（即决策模型）通过校准概率回答输入问题，而非生成文本。在2026年9月首次发布后数周内，它们就被用作重排序器。我们检验其背后的决策微调是否比同一模型的普通重排序微调更具优势。针对六种参数规模从0.6B到27B的Qwen骨干模型，以及十个TREC DL和BEIR数据集，我们比较未微调模型（零样本）、其决策微调版本及其重排序微调版本（其中两个由我们自行训练）。研究结论为：决策微调从未成为更好的重排序器。在0.6B至9B范围内，重排序微调在每个骨干模型上均以5至29点nDCG@10的优势胜出，包括零样本数据集，而在27B时两者持平。在9B以下，决策微调相比直接使用未微调模型并无增益。此外，我们发现决策模型的校准优势取决于问题类型：当询问段落是否回答查询时，4B及以上模型的决策微调版本校准性优于公开发布的重排序微调版本；但若提出稍有差异的问题，则该优势消失。最后，校准性无法弥补排名性能的劣势：在9B以下，重排序微调始终能将更优段落保留在固定阈值内。如需重排序器，请对重排序器进行微调。

summary: Why can a task-preserving rewrite turn a correct answer into a failure while a larger internal change leaves the answer intact? We develop a direction-sensitive, readout-relative account of semantic fragility: heterogeneous language changes can share geometric and readout relationships without sharing an input-independent failure direction. Clean decision reserve, representation transformation, and response alignment provide complementary descriptions of this process. An exact longitudinal-transverse decomposition identifies directional information discarded by scalar transmission. A compact reserve-and-transmission model predicts failures across held-out families and items in Qwen3-32B and Gemma 4 31B, with useful but parameterization-dependent transfer to ReClor. Matched interventions show that orientation carries causal information beyond scalar geometry. Among naturally failed rewrites, attention-component tests on disjoint original items and subsequent answer-order controls favor the natural paired direction over tested random and same-answer-letter donor directions. Yet failures rarely persist across option orders, and current-order corrections use recomputed clean references. Shared predictive regularity thus coexists with context-dependent directional effects. Numerical path integration reduces, but does not eliminate, finite-patch approximation error within a fixed context; a larger discrepancy from the natural rewrite effect remains. A complementary fixed-CoT cue study extends this account to influence unacknowledged in recorded reasoning: readout associations transfer across domains, although the positive-mean causal criterion fails and signed-effect prediction remains post hoc. Together, these results support shared relations among reserve, transformation, and response while distinguishing local causal sensitivity from a complete explanation of natural failure.
title: Many Perturbations, Shared Failure Dynamics: Tracing Direction-Sensitive Perturbation Influence in Language Models
title_translated: 多种扰动，共享失败动态：追踪语言模型中方向敏感扰动的影响
summary_translated: 为何一个保持任务不变的重写会将正确答案变为错误，而更大的内部变化却使答案保持不变？我们提出了一种方向敏感、读出相对的语义脆弱性解释：不同的语言变化可以在不共享输入无关失败方向的情况下，具有几何和读出关系。干净决策储备、表征变换和响应对齐为这一过程提供了互补描述。精确的纵向-横向分解揭示了标量传输所丢弃的方向信息。一个紧凑的储备与传输模型能够预测Qwen3-32B和Gemma 4 31B中未见家族和项目上的失败，且在ReClor上表现出有用但依赖参数化的迁移效果。匹配干预实验表明，方向携带了超越标量几何的因果信息。在自然失败的重写中，对不相交原始项的注意力组件测试以及后续的答案顺序控制支持自然配对方向而非测试的随机或同答案字母来源方向。然而，失败很少在选项顺序间持续存在，当前顺序修正使用重新计算的干净参考。因此，共享的预测规律与上下文相关的方向效应共存。数值路径积分虽能减少但无法消除固定上下文内的有限区域近似误差；与自然重写效应相比仍存在较大差异。一项互补的固定CoT提示研究将此解释扩展到记录推理中未承认的影响：读出关联可在不同领域间传递，尽管正均值因果标准失效，符号效应预测仍为事后分析。总体而言，这些结果支持储备、变换与响应之间的共享关系，同时区分局部因果敏感性与对自然失败的完整解释。

summary: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suffices to control polarity across languages, while responding selectively to negated inputs. Finally, both dense and sparse interventions generalize to four additional languages and FLORES-derived sentences. We release data and code to support future work: this https URL .
title: "Not" is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLMs
title_translated: "不"在翻译中并未丢失：多语言大语言模型中否定表示的因果分析
summary_translated: 否定在每种语言中都会出现，但其表面实现方式差异巨大。尽管如此，多语言大语言模型（LLMs）仍能稳健地翻译否定，这引发了它们是否在跨语言中共享否定底层表示的问题。我们在英语、法语、越南语和中文的六种开源模型中进行研究，使用合成对比数据集和来自FLORES-200的否定翻译数据集进行因果干预。在所有模型中，我们发现强有力的证据表明否定表示是可因果控制的，并且在跨语言间基本共享。特别地，我们证明从一种语言提取的对比激活方向可以诱导或消除其他语言中的否定，且不同语言提取的方向高度一致。此外，我们发现否定由稀疏特征表示：每个模型仅需一个稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征即可控制跨语言极性，同时对否定输入具有选择性响应。密集和稀疏干预均能推广至另外四种语言及FLORES衍生句子。我们发布了数据和代码以支持未来工作：此 https URL。

summary: Looped language models run each token through the same layers several times, and each run is one iteration. To save compute, an extra layer, the halting head, gives after each iteration the probability that the token stops there, so that easy tokens can stop early. Pretraining models from scratch, up to 1.3B parameters, we find two problems. First, heads trained on a mix of all iterations predict that tokens need under half the iterations, yet under the standard stopping rule tokens run almost every iteration, because this training never scores the single iteration where a token stops. Scoring every iteration instead fixes this, but in our runs it works only with a strong penalty favoring early stops. Second, savings are commonly reported as an average number of iterations per token, but when sequences are generated in batches that run until their slowest token stops, a model without a head is almost as good at that cost. The reported average can therefore overstate the saving. We recommend reporting the iterations tokens actually run, with the stopping threshold and batch size, and give a test, run before training a head, that bounds its gain.
title: Do Halting Heads Really Save Compute in Looped Language Models?
title_translated: 停止头真的能节省循环语言模型中的计算吗？
summary_translated: 循环语言模型将每个标记通过相同层多次运行，每次运行称为一次迭代。为节省计算量，额外增加了一个停止头，在每次迭代后给出该标记在此停止的概率，从而使简单标记能提前终止。我们在从头预训练最大达13亿参数的模型时发现两个问题。首先，混合所有迭代训练的头预测标记所需迭代数不足一半，但在标准停止规则下，标记几乎运行完所有迭代，因为训练从未评估标记真正停止的单一迭代。若改为评估每次迭代则可解决此问题，但在我们的实验中仅在强早期停止奖励惩罚下有效。其次，节省常被报告为每标记平均迭代次数，但当序列以批处理方式生成并运行至最慢标记停止时，无停止头的模型在相同成本下几乎同样高效。因此，报告的平均值可能夸大了实际节省。我们建议报告标记实际运行的迭代次数，附带停止阈值和批大小，并提供一个在训练停止头前运行的测试来界定其收益上限。

summary: We propose DIAL-S2ST, a post-training method for learning inference-time latency control in simultaneous speech-to-speech translation models. Our approach reuses pretrained translation capabilities through self-distillation from lookahead predictions, while limiting the influence of large text distillation losses to account for the imitation gap. This provides supervision for earlier emission without paired target data or reward computation. To make the learned timing adjustable at inference, we jointly train a single LoRA adapter across scales with matched lookahead guidance. Experiments on French-to-English translation with Hibiki demonstrate that only 10 hours of source speech enable this adaptation, providing flexible latency control with a favorable quality-latency trade-off.
title: DIAL-S2ST: Learning Latency Control for Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
title_translated: DIAL-S2ST：用于同步语音到语音翻译的延迟控制学习方法
summary_translated: 我们提出了DIAL-S2ST，一种用于同步语音到语音翻译模型在推理时延迟控制的后训练方法。我们的方法通过前瞻预测的自蒸馏重用预训练翻译能力，同时限制大文本蒸馏损失的影响以应对模仿差距。这为早期输出提供了监督，无需成对目标数据或奖励计算。为使学习到的时间控制在推理时可调节，我们联合训练单个LoRA适配器，跨尺度匹配前瞻引导。在Hibiki系统上进行法语到英语翻译的实验表明，仅需10小时源语音即可实现此适应，提供灵活的延迟-质量权衡。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. We release our training and evaluation code alongside the 1.7B and 4B SOPO models at this https URL .
title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
title_translated: SOPO：基于苏格拉底式引导的跨度级幻觉检测策略优化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已在各种自然语言处理任务中广泛应用，但存在生成不忠实或不一致内容的幻觉问题。虽然带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务中展现出良好应用前景，但其在跨度级幻觉检测中的应用面临定位模糊、硬样本奖励稀疏性以及长度不受控膨胀等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们引入苏格拉底式引导策略优化（SOPO），一种用于鲁棒幻觉检测的多轮强化学习框架。SOPO的核心创新在于苏格拉底反馈机制：教师模型通过从真实标签推断的间接提示，在推理过程中指导学生模型的推理轨迹。这种教师引导方式使模型能为困难样本生成更有效的推理路径，从而缓解奖励稀疏性。此外，我们引入基于回合的优势缩放，以惩罚冗余偏差，鼓励模型发展高效自主的推理能力。在RAGTruth上的实证结果表明，SOPO（4B）达到领先性能，超越主流专有模型（如GPT-5）和标准RL基线，且在四个域外基准上报告的平均得分高于GRPO，对CAPO的证据则呈混合状态。我们已发布训练与评估代码，以及17亿和40亿参数的SOPO模型，详见此 https URL。

summary: A collection date records when a source revision was acquired, not when its contents changed. Can assigning this metadata redirect temporal question answering despite unchanged evidence? Swapping the question day and following day between two revisions lowers later-reference exact match (EM) by 37.6-51.4 percentage points across five open-weight LLMs on 595 Wikipedia pages, replicated on 128 disjoint pages. Previous-day swaps retain 29.0-39.6-point losses on 497 pages. Seven prompt variants, including explicit ignore-collection instructions and archived-revision provenance, retain the effect. Fictional answers and English month-name question dates show that remembered answers and identical date strings are unnecessary. Matched thinking reduces Qwen3.5's penalty from 30.1 to 11.1 points, while native reasoners vary. Two API LLMs show small Wikipedia swap effects and rarely shift to earlier answers on fictional records. Large swap-induced losses concentrate around the question date; swaps between distant dates have much smaller effects. Adding fields containing one observed acquisition date lowers EM relative to omission in three of five LLMs after correction. The diagnostic isolates metadata effects from changing evidence or missing the relevant revision, and provides a practical audit for temporal QA inputs.
title: Collection-Date Assignment Redirects Answers in Temporal QA
title_translated: 收集日期赋值可引导时间问答中的答案
summary_translated: 收集日期记录的是源版本被获取的时间，而非其内容变更的时间。即使证据未发生变化，分配这一元数据是否能引导时间问答？在595个维基百科页面上，对两个版本之间的提问日和次日进行交换，导致五个开放权重大语言模型的后期引用精确匹配（EM）下降了37.6至51.4个百分点，并在128个不相交页面上得到复现。前一天的交换在497个页面上仍保持29.0至39.6个百分点的损失。七种提示变体，包括明确忽略收集日期的指令和归档版本来源信息，均保留该效应。虚构答案和英文月份名称的问题日期表明，记住的答案和相同的日期字符串并非必要条件。匹配思维将Qwen3.5的惩罚从30.1点降至11.1点，而原生推理者表现各异。两个API大语言模型在维基百科交换中表现出较小影响，且在虚构记录上很少转向更早的答案。大规模交换引起的损失集中在问题日期附近；远距离日期间的交换影响则小得多。添加包含一个观测获取日期的字段，在修正后使三个大语言模型的EM相对于省略情况有所下降。该诊断方法将元数据效应与证据变化或遗漏相关版本的影响分离开来，为时间问答输入提供了一种实用的审计手段。

summary: Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians' time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also sit inside. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on one host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination; it generated 119 tokens/s for one user and served 16 concurrent requests at 908 tokens/s in total. On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%). Five scenarios with synthetic data ran on combinations of the components: needlestick injury response, batch adverse event grading, scanned referral letter transcription, falls data aggregation and plotting, and investigation of 3 topics by subagents. The platform has run on the hospital network since September 14, 2026.
title: The LLENS Platform for On-Premises Large Language Model Agents in a Japanese University Hospital: Development and Evaluation Study
comment: 49 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, with supplementary material. Submitted to JMIR Medical Informatics
title_translated: 日本大学医院本地部署大语言模型智能体的LLENS平台：开发与评估研究
summary_translated: 使用工具的大语言模型智能体可以承担部分占用医生时间的电子病历和文书工作，但在许多医院中，医疗信息系统运行在封闭网络内，因此模型和智能体框架也必须部署在内部。我们设计、实现并部署了LLENS——一个运行在北海道大学医院封闭网络内的临床支持AI智能体平台，基于单台主机配备8块NVIDIA H200 GPU，采用开源权重模型Kimi K2.6（约1万亿参数），以及从Open WebUI重构的Web应用。该框架包含10个组件，包括页面图像读取、全文附件输入、无向量索引的路径地址文档树、网络隔离沙箱、成果物返回、生成输出的自检、子智能体和保存的流程。Kimi K2.6从3个开源候选模型中选出，在2026年日本医学执照考试中得分480/500；单用户生成速率为119 token/s，总服务16个并发请求时达到908 token/s。在180个医院文档问题（每题3个种子）上，无文档时平均准确率为10.7%，固定检索（一次词汇搜索前10段）下为81.3%，交互访问下达97.2%（比固定检索高15.9个百分点，95%置信区间10.9-21.3）；差异主要体现在筛选/计数类问题（16.7% vs 87.8%）。五种合成数据场景测试了组件组合：针刺伤应对、批量不良事件分级、扫描转录推荐信、跌倒数据聚合与绘图，以及由子智能体调查三个主题。该平台自2026年9月14日起已在医院网络中运行。

summary: Election Commitment Mining refers to the analysis of election commitments made by electoral candidates or political parties during election campaigns. However, many elected candidates and political parties, especially in developing South Asian countries, do not fully deliver on the promises they make before elections. Even after the elections, commitments presented through election manifestos, posters, pamphlets, videos, and other campaign materials are often not systematically or transparently archived. As a result, these promises tend to fade away over time, making it difficult to hold the elected candidates accountable for their commitments. To address this persistent issue, this research aims to develop a system capable of structuring the commitments made by candidates during election periods. In this work, we created the first gold-standard dataset of Nepali political texts (Cohen's kappa = 0.777) and evaluated machine learning, deep learning and large language models to automatically extract and analyze election commitments. LaBSE-LR achieved the best results among machine learning models (0.897 accuracy, 0.896 macro F1-score, 0.947 AUROC), while fastText-LSTM achieved the highest performance among deep learning models (0.914 accuracy, 0.913 macro F1-score, 0.961 AUROC). Among the three evaluated large language models, Qwen3-8B performed best in the few-shot setting (0.848 macro F1-score). The outcome of this work is integrated into a mobile application, where commitments can be visualized with the support of GAI, enhancing transparency, civic engagement, and electoral accountability.
title: From Promises to Accountability: Comparative AI Modeling and Visualization of Electoral Commitments in Nepali Political Texts
