title_translated: SPOOK：视觉编码器中离流形知识的稀疏像素优化
summary_translated: 现代视觉编码器广泛用作语义表示，但嵌入相似性与人类可见语义之间的关系在远离自然图像流形的区域可能变得模糊。我们通过在空白画布上应用稀疏像素编辑，并采用简单的逐像素爬山过程，在黑箱设置下探测这一区域。在ImageNet和Flickr30k上，我们评估这些经过编辑的空白画布能否在多模态对比编码器和自监督视觉编码器中检索选定目标。在OpenCLIP上，针对类别提示优化的输入实现了强大的top-1和top-5目标检索性能；在DINOv3上，针对类别原型优化的输入实现了高目标对齐度和接近顶级原型的排名。这些结果表明，对原本空白、视觉上无语义的输入进行稀疏编辑，可以在语言对齐和自监督视觉表示空间中进入目标语义盆地。我们的发现揭示了现代视觉编码器在离流形区域的共性失效模式，并建议将稀疏空白画布优化作为一种简单探针来考察表示几何结构。

summary: We learn schedules for a continuous penalty relaxation of MAX-CUT by backpropagating through an unrolled classical solver. A state-blind schedule generalizes to instances substantially larger than those used for training. A state-adaptive bilinear schedule also generalizes out of distribution, outperforming its untrained baseline across 15 seeds ($t=4.1$). By contrast, an additive ablation with identical inputs and output heads is statistically indistinguishable from the bilinear model in distribution but performs worse than its own baseline out of distribution ($t=-11.7$). This separation appears without regularization and persists across a $30$ round weight-decay sweep: the bilinear advantage remains significant at every tested value, whereas the additive model never recovers. The results in this setting isolate how solver state enters the schedule, rather than state adaptivity alone, as the architectural distinction associated with out-of-distribution transfer.
title: Multiplicative vs. Additive State Coupling in Learned Optimizer Schedules
title_translated: 学习优化器调度中乘法与加法状态耦合的比较
summary_translated: 我们通过反向传播经过展开的经典求解器，学习MAX-CUT连续惩罚松弛的调度策略。一种无状态感知的调度策略能够泛化到远大于训练实例的规模。一种状态自适应的双线性调度策略也表现出分布外泛化能力，在15个种子实验中均优于未训练的基线模型（t=4.1）。相比之下，具有相同输入和输出头的加法消融模型在分布内与双线性模型统计上无差异，但在分布外表现却显著劣于其自身基线（t=-11.7）。这种差异在无正则化条件下依然存在，并在30轮权重衰减扫描中持续保持：双线性优势在所有测试值下均显著，而加法模型从未恢复。该结果表明，在此设置中，调度中求解器状态的引入方式（而非仅状态自适应性）才是导致分布外迁移的关键架构差异。

summary: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.
title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
title_translated: ActionRAG：用于LLM智能体长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散机制
summary_translated: LLM智能体需要具备从不断增长的交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致的证据的能力，尤其是在答案依赖事实间关系而非孤立语义匹配的情况下。当前的记忆流水线在两个阶段仍易受攻击：索引错误可能导致重复实体被分割或不同实体被合并；在线检索通常将初始相似度分数视为最终结果，即使周围图结构提供了修正证据。我们提出ActionRAG，一种耦合谨慎索引与查询时图回溯评估的图记忆架构。其索引流程协调类型标签并应用分层实体解析。给定查询后，双通道实体与三元组检索形成初始证据集并诱导出一个有界局部图。查询条件下的接收器归一化扩散利用局部路径结构精炼三元组得分。种子保护、中心节点惩罚通量及三元组显式化机制在保留直接证据的同时恢复遗漏连接。我们在MemoryAgentBench（MAB）上评估ActionRAG，该基准测试涵盖准确检索、冲突解决、长程理解及测试时学习能力。在MAB的八个确定性评分列中，ActionRAG平均准确率达到55.1%，比最强的基于检索的记忆基线提升5.4个百分点。在MAB的查询时成本核算下，平均合成成本低于每查询0.001美元（四个报告成本列），在我们的消费级Apple Silicon设备上，单独测量的检索侧p99组件总和为440.7毫秒。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as interconnected agents, a fundamental question emerges: does individual cooperation translate into collective cooperation? We investigate this question through the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD), moving from dyadic interactions to homogeneous and heterogeneous networks of open-weight LLMs. Our findings reveal that cooperation is highly sensitive to model composition and seemingly minor linguistic changes. Models that cooperate with identical peers can shift toward defection in mixed populations. A simple uncertainty cue can increase or decrease cooperation, redistribute costs, and affect unexposed agents several hops away. Even reversing action-label order can dramatically alter behavior, with uncertainty framing sometimes amplifying this sensitivity. Together, these findings challenge the notion of cooperation as a stable model-level property, revealing how strategic behavior depends on interaction partners, network positions, and the language used to frame decisions.
title: The Butterfly Defects: Tracing Cooperation in LLM Agent Networks
title_translated: 蝴蝶缺陷：追踪LLM智能体网络中的合作行为
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地以互联智能体的形式运行，一个根本性问题浮现：个体合作是否能转化为集体合作？我们通过迭代囚徒困境（IPD）研究这一问题，从二元互动扩展到同质与异质的开放权重LLM网络。研究发现，合作行为对模型构成和看似微小的语言变化极为敏感。与相同同伴合作的模型在混合群体中可能转向背叛。一个简单的不确定性提示可以增加或减少合作，重新分配成本，并影响数跳之外的未暴露智能体。甚至反转动作标签顺序也能显著改变行为，不确定性框架有时会放大这种敏感性。这些发现挑战了合作作为稳定模型属性的观点，揭示了战略行为如何依赖于交互伙伴、网络位置以及决策表述的语言。

summary: Learned representations often encode sensitive attributes, such as gender or race, that may be undesirable or unsafe to retain. Concept erasure aims to remove this information while preserving task-relevant content. Existing methods remain incomplete: linear methods provide guarantees only against linear probes, while nonlinear methods achieve stronger empirical erasure but lack formal guarantees and often sacrifice utility. In this work, we introduce a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure. We follow the principle that erasure should remove only the sensitive attribute and nothing else, and we show that, under the stated assumptions, perfect reconstruction together with population-level independence is sufficient for perfect nonlinear guardedness, with preservation guarantees in the imperfect-reconstruction regime. Empirically, we attain a superior utility-erasure trade-off across multiple datasets, sensitive attributes, and language models, surpassing even the supervised variants of competing methods despite using no target-task labels, while being simpler to optimize and converging substantially faster. Beyond erasure, our framework yields concept conversion (representation steering) as a by-product: by changing only the target concept at inference time, it produces representations corresponding to different concept values - at no additional training cost - a capability no prior erasure method provides, and on which we likewise demonstrate strong empirical performance.
title: Principled Nonlinear Concept Erasure and Steering
title_translated: 原则性非线性概念擦除与引导
summary_translated: 学习到的表示通常编码了性别、种族等敏感属性，这些信息可能不希望或不安全地保留。概念擦除旨在移除这些信息的同时保留任务相关的内容。现有方法仍不完整：线性方法仅对线性探测提供保证，而非线性方法虽实现更强的实证擦除效果，但缺乏形式化保证，且常牺牲实用性。本文提出一种原则性的条件自编码器框架用于非线性概念擦除。我们遵循的原则是：擦除应仅移除敏感属性，不涉及其他任何内容。在给定假设下，我们证明完美重建与总体层面独立性足以实现完美的非线性保护性，且在重建不完美情况下仍可提供保留保证。实证上，我们在多个数据集、敏感属性和语言模型上实现了更优的效用-擦除权衡，即使不使用目标任务标签，也超越了竞争方法的监督变体，同时优化更简单、收敛更快。除擦除外，该框架还能自然产生概念转换（表示引导）：仅在推理时更改目标概念，即可生成对应不同概念值的表示——无需额外训练成本——这是以往任何擦除方法无法提供的能力，我们也展示了其强大的实证性能。

summary: Large language models serve applications with diverse inference budgets, but training and maintaining separate models for each budget incurs substantial costs. Recent Looped Transformers enable flexible inference computation through parameter reuse, but maintaining strong performance across different inference budgets remains an open challenge. We introduce Accordion, a mixture-of-experts-based model that supports five inference budgets through fixed-prefix layer looping. Each budget follows a pre-defined execution path, while the minimum budget retains the unlooped model. Joint pretraining samples one budget per micro-batch and optimizes its next-token prediction loss without additional cross-budget consistency objectives. We further preserve these inference budgets through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, where parameter-group merging and budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation integrate three domain experts into one model. After 3.6T tokens of pretraining, increasing inference depth improves Accordion-6B-A0.5B's five-category macro-average across 37 tasks by 3.01 percentage points, with the middle budget capturing 89% of this gain using half as many additional layer executions. The final model surpasses each domain expert on its corresponding task-and-budget average, while achieving strong instruction-following performance across all budgets and retaining depth-dependent gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation.
title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
title_translated: Accordion：通过固定前缀层循环实现弹性深度推理
summary_translated: 大型语言模型服务于具有多样化推理预算的应用场景，但为每个预算训练和维护独立模型会带来巨大成本。近期的循环Transformer通过参数复用实现了灵活的推理计算，但在不同推理预算下维持高性能仍是开放挑战。我们提出Accordion，一种基于专家混合的模型，支持五种推理预算，通过固定前缀层循环实现。每个预算遵循预定义的执行路径，最低预算保留未循环模型。联合预训练在每个微批次中采样一个预算，并优化其下一个词预测损失，无需额外的跨预算一致性目标。我们进一步通过监督微调和强化学习保留这些推理预算，其中参数组合并与预算匹配的多教师在线蒸馏将三个领域专家整合为单一模型。经过3.6万亿token的预训练，增加推理深度使Accordion-6B-A0.5B在37个任务上的五类宏平均准确率提升3.01个百分点，中间预算仅用一半额外层执行就捕获了89%的增益。最终模型在各自任务与预算平均值上均超越每个领域专家，同时在所有预算下保持出色的指令遵循能力，并在数学推理和代码生成中保留深度相关的增益。

summary: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.
title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
title_translated: 当智能体失败时：是模型还是执行框架的错？
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体将模型与执行框架相结合，因此智能体基准测试的表现反映了两者的协同行为。我们主张应通过模型与框架之间的交互来评估框架。为此，我们提出一个包含五项互补度量的框架：(i) 有效完成率（VCR），衡量智能体在不依赖任务正确性的情况下可靠完成任务并生成可评估结果的能力；(ii) 模型-框架适配度，衡量某一框架在给定模型下通过有效完成支持任务达成的能力；(iii) 跨模型适配度，衡量框架在不同模型上的整体适用性；(iv) 交互残差，揭示组件层面汇总所掩盖的特定配对执行中的优劣势；(v) Token负载，包括失败尝试在内的智能体执行所需的Token总量。我们在六个涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互和成果交接的基准上，评估了四种通用框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI 和 DeepAgents）与四种核心模型，以及两个固定原生模型-框架系统。包含原生参照和压力条件，共111个评估场景产生52,168条轨迹。框架排名随模型和基准变化；任务性能与有效完成率可能偏好不同的组合，相似的任务得分也可能伴随截然不同的执行特征。OpenCode在跨模型表现中排名第一，而DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview在共享四个基准面板上，所有框架中均保持一致的高平均VCR。这些发现支持评估模型-框架交互、在模型中训练可迁移的框架使用能力，以及针对模型和任务定制框架设计。

summary: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additional training-time relational evidence to guide reasoning exploration. To translate the posterior's broader exploration into inference-time improvements, we derive an importance-weighted variational objective and instantiate it as a prior-posterior co-evolution framework that improves both modes under a shared inference-compatible reward while selectively transferring posterior trajectories to the prior according to their utility and prior reachability. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, PILOT outperforms the primary baseline across all 12 task groups at both 2B and 7B parameters, improving overall scores by 3.2 and 3.3 points, respectively, with the largest gains in visual-document retrieval (+6.1 and +6.4 points). Our results show that relational supervision is most valuable not as a post-hoc reward but as a signal for shaping how reasoning is explored in training reasoning-enhanced embedding models.
title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings
title_translated: 超越事后奖励：用于多模态嵌入的特权推理探索
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的进步推动了多模态嵌入技术的显著发展。近期方法通过在嵌入输入中加入自生成推理来增强生成能力，以生成更具信息量的嵌入。然而，传统的检索监督在训练嵌入模型时仅指定成对的相关关系，未明确引导输入增强所用的推理过程。此类推理既非直接可观测，也并非由输入唯一决定，允许多种合理的推理路径引入不同检索效用的语义线索。现有方法大多仅基于输入优化推理，限制了对与检索相关路径的探索。我们提出PILOT框架，将推理建模为潜在变量，并将先验与后验分布分别实例化为共享MLLM的不同推理模式。先验仅依赖于输入，而后验则利用训练期间的额外关系证据来引导推理探索。为将后验更广泛探索转化为推理阶段的改进，我们推导出一种重要性加权变分目标，并将其实例化为先验-后验协同演化框架，在共享推理兼容奖励下同时优化两种模式，同时根据其效用和先验可达性选择性地将后验轨迹转移至先验。在78个任务的MMEB-V2基准上，PILOT在2B和7B参数规模下均优于主要基线，总体得分分别提升3.2和3.3分，视觉文档检索任务提升最大（+6.1和+6.4分）。结果表明，关系监督的价值不仅在于作为事后奖励，更在于作为训练推理增强嵌入模型时塑造推理探索方式的信号。

summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.
title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
title_translated: 思维循环：面向文档图像中表格视觉问答的自评价迭代推理
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展显著提升了视觉问答（VQA）性能，但其对表格等结构化内容的推理仍不稳定，常受空间错位和逻辑幻觉困扰。现有改进表格VQA的方法通常依赖架构修改或昂贵的监督微调（SFT），由于需要大规模专家标注数据集和大量计算资源，进入门槛较高。本文提出Self-RefineVQA，一种无需训练、仅在推理阶段运行的自纠正框架，可在不增加标注数据或更新模型的前提下提升表格VQA性能。受人类修订行为启发，该方法使单一VLM能够迭代扮演生成者、批评者和修正者角色，形成闭环自我反馈回路，通过提示引导的重新评估纠正常见推理错误。在表格VQA基准上的实验表明，Self-RefineVQA在单语和跨语言理解中均带来稳定准确率提升，尤其对小型模型效果显著，使轻量级模型（如2B-7B参数）达到远超自身规模的性能水平。此外，我们提供了对比复杂度分析，表明尽管推理成本线性增长，但本框架具备更高的数据效率和更低的累积成本，避免了微调所需的人工标注瓶颈。结果凸显了基于提示的自提升在VLM中实现可靠表格推理方面的可扩展性和可访问性潜力。

summary: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.
title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
title_translated: 4DMemory：通过框架增强智能体进行长时序时空记忆基准测试
summary_translated: 人类能高效处理跨越数小时至数年的多模态流，构建持久且精细的时空记忆，以支持对长期事件的推理与预测。相比之下，现有基准主要聚焦短中等上下文任务，大多数基础模型难以在长时序中保持精细信息。为评估并改进长时序时空推理能力，我们引入LongVideo数据集和4DMemoryBench。LongVideo包含约900小时视频及超过5,000个经人工审核的问题，覆盖多样上下文长度下的视觉、文本和时空推理。我们进一步开发了4DMemory框架，集成四项互补技能、22个以上专用工具模型以及模型特定的检索增强生成系统。在13个领先模型上的评估显示，独立的基础模型在长时序任务中表现不佳，而4DMemory框架使所有模型性能提升超过50%。相较于以往基准，相同模型在4DMemoryBench上的性能下降超过10%。我们希望4DMemory能推动具备处理复杂、长时序任务能力的时空智能体的发展。

summary: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: this https URL .
title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks

title_translated: DMAIC-Bench：从自我反思到自我约束——面向多阶段分析任务的智能体
summary_translated: 多阶段分析任务要求LLM智能体利用中间证据判断是否继续、转向或终止。自我反思（即智能体批判自身输出）已被广泛研究，但一次批判并不反映证据是否改变了下一步行动。我们将这种能力称为“自我约束”。现有智能体基准大多仅衡量任务完成度或输出质量，未对此进行测试。DMAIC-Bench围绕精益六西格玛的明确统计前提，构建了15个工业案例中的97个种子任务，涵盖四个行业领域。成对的反事实变体要求在相同工作流位置采取相反动作，从而区分有依据的约束与随意停止。我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，最终结论通过独立专家评审。在来自六家供应商的13个模型中，匹配GO决策的执行级路由准确率为92%，而NO-GO决策仅为19%（任何被禁止的下游计算均视为路由错误）。执行轨迹显示，智能体在执行分析前已报告正确诊断，但这些结果实际上不允许后续分析。单独的盲评专家对11个审计智能体的评估表明，在达到NO-GO决策时，有47%的报告基于无效证据，置信区间为31%至61%。显式停止权限虽帮助部分模型，但并未一致恢复GO和NO-GO分支的正确决策。16个生命科学任务（涉及批量核糖核酸测序RNA-seq和病例对照全基因组关联研究GWAS）表明，该框架可评估超出工业工作流的证据依赖性决策。项目代码与数据已公开。

summary: Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query--key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are frozen during long-context continual pretraining, suggesting that wider heads not only benefit updates in attention modules but lead to more effective adaptation of components such as embeddings and MLPs.
title: Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval
title_translated: 头维度在长上下文检索语言模型中的重要性
summary_translated: 多头注意力通过查询-键交互和值聚合来检索并组合上下文表示，头维度限制了每头的表示空间。在长上下文处理中，尚未明确将固定的参数预算分配给更少但更宽的头是否能提升信息检索效果。本文研究了头维度对长上下文检索任务性能的影响。实证研究表明，预训练损失和短上下文非检索任务性能受头维度影响较小，而在固定模型规模下，更宽的头能显著提升长上下文检索性能。我们发现，具有更宽头的模型中，更多头被用于检索，从而将更多参数分配给检索任务。消融实验还表明，即使在长上下文持续预训练期间注意力模块的投影权重被冻结，更宽的头仍能提升检索性能，说明更宽的头不仅有利于注意力模块的更新，还能促进嵌入和MLP等组件更有效的适应。

summary: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.
title: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
title_translated: SWE-Shift：在动态工作空间中评估编码智能体
summary_translated: 现有的仓库级编码基准大多假设任务和环境在整个执行过程中保持不变。但在软件开发中，代码、依赖项、运行时状态和需求可能在智能体仍在工作时发生变化。我们提出了SWE-Shift，一个用于评估智能体在执行过程中遭遇变更情况下的表现的基准。从相同的保存历史和工作空间出发，Clean延续无干预地继续，而匹配的Shifted延续则接收与任务相关的更新。成功需要完成当前任务、保留仍然有效的成果，并满足适用的状态和证据检查。该基准包含12个变化类别共120种场景，每个场景在九个预定干预位置进行评估。我们评估了17个编码智能体系统，所有系统在Shifted场景下的成功率均低于Clean场景。GPT-6 Astra的成功率从67.35%降至24.79%，配对成功率仅为20.34%。工具/会话变更和过期证据导致所有系统配对成功率为零。部分系统在后期干预位置的配对成功率较低，而另一些则较高。这些结果表明，在任务未改变的情况下取得成功，仍可能伴随无法保留工作、恢复状态或刷新证据的失败。

summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.
title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
title_translated: 视觉-语言模型中的深度依赖安全几何：层间定位与双向拒绝控制
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）被广泛部署，但其安全行为背后的内部机制仍不清晰。我们提出了一种轻量级的推理时框架，可在不重新训练或修改参数的情况下，定位并操控冻结VLM中的安全敏感表示。在Qwen3-VL-4B上，逐层激活发散分析揭示了深度方向上的非均匀安全几何结构。因果干预表明，早期视觉层通过沿学习到的安全方向进行激活引导，支持强大的双向拒绝控制，不安全拒绝范围可达6%-96%；而后期层则更依赖激活幅度缩放，表现出显著的安全选择性权衡。深层层在安全方向上仍保持良好分离，但对引导作用不敏感，这区分了表征可分性与因果可控性。InternVL2.5-4B尽管层位置和幅度存在差异，也表现出定性相似的深度依赖激活几何。我们的结果揭示了VLM视觉编码器中一种白盒、表示层面的拒绝绕过攻击面，并推动了推理时对安全敏感表示的稳定化。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM's uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check's reliability is given. title: Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLMs
title_translated: 并非所有信息都值得询问：基于大语言模型的决策导向信息获取
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于在信息不完整的情况下支持决策，其中决定查什么以及何时停止，与最终答案同等重要。然而，LLMs容易陷入信息陷阱：它们会支付那些无法改变决策或成本高于收益的核查代价，并在证据已足够时仍持续提问。为此，我们提出了决策导向的信息价值获取（DIVA），一种简单但高效的LLM信息获取方法，基于证据的决策价值。DIVA 1）让LLM通过简短的数值问题指定一个小型决策模型，即坏结果的可能性以及每次核查如何改变这一概率；2）根据想象中结果改善决策净收益（减去成本）来评估每个候选核查，当没有核查值得其成本时停止。其变体DIVA-U进一步考虑了LLM对其所做核查影响强度估计的不确定性。DIVA无需训练，适用于任何LLM。在四个领域和20个LLM上，DIVA-U在真实数据上的遗憾（相对于最优决策的价值损失）低于所有LLM基线，主要通过在证据充足后及时停止；在合成场景中，DIVA将最佳LLM基线的遗憾降低75%，其中每个核查的可靠性均已知。

summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.
title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
title_translated: SyncPro：用于主动流式视频理解的同步推理与响应
summary_translated: 主动流式视频理解要求助手跟踪不断发展的事件，并在用户请求的条件满足时作出响应。为此，助手必须积累相关证据，并随着新观察结果的到来重新评估响应条件。现有工作为这一过程提供了互补能力：主动视频助手学习何时响应，而流式视频推理方法生成计划中的中间文本以组织观察结果并支持后续回答。这两者共同构成了主动推理的基础，但如何协调持续推理与及时响应仍缺乏探索。直接适配中，固定的推理间隔可能在无相关信息变化时触发更新，或推迟有用更新直到下一个预定步骤。共享单一生成路径也耦合了两个不同需求：保留未来决策所需的证据，以及仅生成用户请求的响应。此外，响应必须等待推理完成，即使已有充分证据。为解决这些问题，我们引入SyncPro，一种具有专用生成路径的同步双流框架，分别用于证据追踪和面向用户的响应。其内部分支和响应分支共享因果历史且独立激活，使相关证据变化能触发内部更新，同时响应可与正在进行的推理并发进行。我们构建了18.9万条双流样本，通过监督微调和轨迹级强化学习训练SyncPro。在三个主动基准上的实验显示，其响应时机更优，对用户请求的回答更准确。

summary: RVL-CDIP is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, and reported accuracy on it is now 98.8%. In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5% of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2% of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set. Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them. Image-only models trained on RVL-CDIP lose 16 to 28 points on documents from other sources, and the choice of OCR engine changes accuracy by 4.1 to 8.3 points. We find that nearly 16,000 RVL-CDIP documents contain sensitive personal data, and produce de-identified versions of these documents. We re-benchmark 25 models, and with all defects remediated, the 13 that we retrain are 0.9 to 2.9 points more accurate than in the original condition; the most accurate of them, LayoutLMv3, is 96.5% accurate. We release the corrected corpus, the annotations and the out-of-distribution data.
title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
title_translated: RVL-CDIP中的数据质量：系统性审计
summary_translated: RVL-CDIP是文档分类领域的事实标准基准，目前报告的准确率已达到98.8%。本文对RVL-CDIP的数据质量进行了系统性审计，发现其约10.5%的40万份文档存在标签错误，且测试集中有35.2%的样本在训练集中存在重复或近似重复。仅通过页面上的标识码即可实现69%的分类准确率，而最先进的模型在去除这些标识码后准确率下降11个百分点。仅使用图像训练的模型在其他来源的文档上准确率下降16至28个百分点，OCR引擎的选择会导致准确率变化4.1至8.3个百分点。我们发现近16,000份RVL-CDIP文档包含敏感个人数据，并生成了去标识化版本。我们重新评估了25个模型，在修复所有缺陷后，重新训练的13个模型准确率比原始条件高出0.9至2.9个百分点；其中最准确的LayoutLMv3模型准确率为96.5%。我们发布了修正后的语料库、标注数据以及分布外数据。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) generation offers an opportunity to intervene before a reasoning model completes its answer. But does the point at which risk is easiest to detect also offer the most effective control? We study this question with REACT, a conditional activation intervention that learns a safety direction from paired safe and unsafe trajectories and applies it once to an early CoT hidden state. The model weights remain frozen, and all subsequent tokens are generated without further edits. To study timing, we train directions separately at each of the first five CoT positions and evaluate ungated edits with full post-edit regeneration. Across three distilled reasoning models and three generation seeds, the strongest gains concentrate in a two- to three-token early window; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the effect falls to approximately zero at the fourth and fifth tokens, even though later states can be more predictive of risk. This separates risk readability from effective control: intervention timing must be evaluated through its effect on subsequent generation. On the same 8B model, REACT raises the rate of fully safe CoT-answer outputs on StrongREJECT-273 from 29.06% to 82.05%, while keeping benign refusal and usefulness near baseline. An anonymized implementation is available at this https URL .
title: REACT: Representational Early Analysis and Control of Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
title_translated: REACT：链式思维轨迹的表征早期分析与控制
summary_translated: 链式思维（CoT）生成为在推理模型完成答案前进行干预提供了机会。但风险最容易被检测的时机是否也最具控制效果？我们通过REACT——一种基于成对安全与不安全轨迹学习安全方向并仅对早期CoT隐藏状态应用一次的条件激活干预方法——来研究这一问题。模型权重保持冻结，后续所有标记均无需进一步修改。为研究干预时机，我们在前五个CoT位置分别训练方向，并在完整重生成条件下评估无门控编辑效果。在三个精简推理模型和三个生成种子下，最强增益集中在前两到三个标记的早期窗口；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型上，第四和第五个标记处效果降至约零，尽管后期状态对风险更具预测性。这表明风险可读性与有效控制是分离的：干预时机必须通过其对后续生成的影响来评估。在同一8B模型上，REACT将StrongREJECT-273测试集上完全安全的CoT输出率从29.06%提升至82.05%，同时保持良性拒绝和有用性接近基线水平。匿名实现代码可在该链接获取。

summary: Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. When a theory does not capture the transformer behaviors relevant to a task, its predictions break down; for instance, we show that the $k$-hop induction task is predicted hard by C-RASP because it does not model content-dependent attention, but we train small transformers on this task that length-generalize. Similarly, theories assuming hard attention like $\mathsf{AC}^0$ and BAPO predict binary majority to be hard, for which we also find success in practice. Together, our results point to several specific features that a theory of transformers must capture: soft rather than hard attention, dynamic content-dependent retrieval, bounded computation at each position, an account of learnability and inductive biases, and a combination of upper and lower bounds.
title: Putting Transformer Theories to the Test
title_translated: 对Transformer理论的检验
summary_translated: 已有多种形式理论被提出以刻画Transformer架构的能力与局限，每种理论采用不同的抽象方式，捕捉架构的不同特征。由于其底层假设和概念框架的差异，这些理论在预测Transformer处理某些任务的难易程度时可能产生分歧。我们梳理了七种Transformer能力理论（星自由、AC⁰、TC⁰、C-RASP、MPC、BAPO和敏感性），并将它们的结果统一映射到涵盖不同计算结构的任务矩阵中。我们补充了新的理论结果以完善该矩阵。随后，通过受控实验测量分布内样本复杂度、长度泛化能力和预训练语言模型性能，对理论预测进行评估。结果表明，没有单一理论能解释观察到的成功与失败模式。当某理论未能捕捉任务相关的Transformer行为时，其预测即失效；例如，C-RASP理论因未建模内容依赖注意力而预测k跳归纳任务困难，但我们训练的小型Transformer在该任务上实现了长度泛化。类似地，假设硬注意力的AC⁰和BAPO理论预测二元多数任务困难，而实践中我们同样取得了成功。综合来看，一个有效的Transformer理论必须包含：软注意力而非硬注意力、动态内容依赖检索、每个位置的有限计算、对可学习性和归纳偏置的解释，以及上下界结合的描述。

summary: Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours' positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in coding, analysis and experimentation needed to support its wider use.
title: Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents
comment: Under review by Nature Machine Intelligence
title_translated: 大语言模型驱动智能体的行为分析
summary_translated: 理解语言-智能体行为需要学习动作在轨迹中的组织方式，以及这种组织如何与上下文和结果相关联。我们提出一个通用框架，将数据驱动的行为发现与分析及实验探究相连接。从记录活动发展出的类别定义了测量内容。分析保留行为在过程中的位置，并将其关系表达为可解释的假设。在保留上下文中进行统计评估和检验，以考察证据的强度与范围。实验（包括提示引导）则测试在刻意变化的条件下行为与结果的变化情况。通过对迭代自我反思的研究，展示了发现、依赖学习与提示比较之间的相互促进作用。我们针对不同长度、事件顺序和智能体角色的轨迹开发了该方法，并识别出支持其广泛应用所需的编码、分析与实验方面的改进。

summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can assess cognitive impairment (CI) from speech, yet their answers reveal neither which internal components control the decision nor how much CI information is accessible in their representations. We investigate both questions through CI-contrast neurons (CICNs), selected by class-contrastive activation frequency in decoder MLPs. Across eight open LALMs and two corpora (Pitt and PROCESS-2), we causally test CICNs against size- and layer-matched random masks and activity-matched controls. In three of the five models that meet our eligibility criteria, ablation of small CICN sets causes large, class-directed prediction shifts; speech-identified masks also control transcript-only decisions, and three of four primary Pitt masks retain specificity on PROCESS-2. Position-restricted interventions locate the influence before the final answer position, most strongly after the speech or transcript evidence under letter-labeled options, largely as a decision-direction shift. Beyond causal localization, supervised linear readouts of frozen CICN activations achieve 0.92--0.97 AUC within Pitt, versus 0.67--0.84 for the models' direct answers. Matched random and all-neuron readouts reach comparable performance; top-ranked CICNs show only an exploratory advantage at very small unit budgets. These results distinguish concentrated causal control over output decisions from broadly distributed diagnostic information for CI detection in LALMs.
title: Concentrated Causal Influence, Distributed Diagnostic Information: Cognitive Impairment Decisions in Large Audio-Language Models
title_translated: 集中因果影响与分布式诊断信息：大音视频语言模型中的认知障碍决策
summary_translated: 大型音视频语言模型（LALMs）能够通过语音判断认知障碍（CI），但其回答并未揭示哪些内部组件控制决策，也未说明CI信息在其表示中有多大的可访问性。我们通过CI对比神经元（CICNs）——在解码器MLP中通过类别对比激活频率选择——来研究这两个问题。在八个开源LALMs和两个语料库（Pitt和PROCESS-2）上，我们对CICNs进行了因果测试，对比大小和层数匹配的随机掩码以及活性匹配的对照组。在符合我们筛选标准的五个模型中，有三个模型的小规模CICN集合删减会导致显著的、类别导向的预测变化；语音识别掩码也能控制仅基于转录文本的决策，且四个主要Pitt掩码中有三个在PROCESS-2上仍保持特异性。位置受限干预定位到最终答案之前的影响，尤其在字母标记选项下的语音或转录证据之后最为强烈，主要表现为决策方向的改变。除了因果定位外，对冻结的CICN激活进行监督线性读出在Pitt语料库中达到0.92–0.97 AUC，远高于模型直接输出的0.67–0.84 AUC。匹配的随机神经元和全神经元读出也达到相当性能；在极小单元预算下，顶级CICNs仅表现出探索性优势。这些结果区分了输出决策的集中因果控制与CI检测中广泛分布的诊断信息。

summary: Deploying language agents in real applications demands more than the right answer: an agent must execute a multi-step business process correctly, follow domain-specific rules, and interact with a user across a dialogue, where the gap between saying and doing is the gap between a satisfied customer and a real loss. We argue that a deployable-agent benchmark should jointly assess four facets: the outcome an agent reaches, the trajectory it takes, its operational viability, and its policy compliance. Customer relationship management (CRM), where mutable records meet operational rules and consequential effects, exercises all four. We introduce CRM-Agent-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark of 555 stateful, multi-turn tasks across nine business domains and 36 capability tags. Each task supplies a task-specific executable contract drawn from checks over actions, arguments, order, response, target state, and protected state; success is the strict conjunction of the checks declared for that task. We evaluate the complete agent system through these contracts and report scored coverage, latency, and cost. Across sixteen systems evaluated on the audited final release, strict success spans 64.32% to 83.60%; the closely grouped leading systems nonetheless diverge sharply in cost and per-domain reliability. CRM-Agent-Bench offers an auditable framework for measuring contract-grounded business-transaction integrity and adherence to task-declared benchmark policies, with a portable structure designed for extension as models improve. Github repository: this https URL
title: CRM-Agent-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents in Stateful Enterprise Environments
title_translated: CRM-Agent-Bench：在有状态企业环境中的工具使用智能体的基准测试
summary_translated: 在真实应用中部署语言智能体不仅需要正确的答案，还要求智能体能够正确执行多步骤业务流程、遵循特定领域的规则，并在对话中与用户交互，其中“说”与“做”之间的差距决定了客户是否满意以及是否造成实际损失。我们认为，可部署的智能体基准应综合评估四个维度：智能体达成的结果、其执行轨迹、操作可行性以及策略合规性。客户关系管理（CRM）领域涉及可变记录、操作规则和 consequential effects，恰好涵盖了这四个方面。我们提出了 CRM-Agent-Bench，这是一个基于执行的基准，包含 across nine business domains 和 36 capability tags 的 555 个有状态、多轮任务。每个任务提供一个特定于任务的可执行合约，涵盖对动作、参数、顺序、响应、目标状态和受保护状态的检查；成功是针对该任务声明的所有检查的严格合取。我们通过这些合约评估完整的智能体系统，并报告得分覆盖率、延迟和成本。在十六个系统在审计后的最终版本上进行评估，严格成功率在 64.32% 到 83.60% 之间；尽管领先系统的成功率相近，但在成本和各领域可靠性方面却存在显著差异。CRM-Agent-Bench 提供了一个可审计的框架，用于衡量合同基础的业务交易完整性和任务声明基准政策的遵守情况，其可移植结构设计为随着模型改进而扩展。GitHub 仓库：this https URL

summary: AI models already inform clinical decisions and draft notes in Australian clinical software, usually without the practitioner being told which model is used. Existing medical benchmarks are written for other jurisdictions. We wrote 142 questions from Australian guidelines and schedules across five domains (PBS authority, MBS billing, Ahpra obligations, triage red flags, immunisation and screening), each with one verifiable answer scored by exact match. Each question ran blind and with the governing clause supplied, which separates failure to recall the current rule from failure to apply it. We tested 28 models between July and October 2026. Blind accuracy ranged from 51.5% to 92.7%, and the highest-scoring models could not be separated. Of 791 failed model-question pairs, 684 (86%) were wrong blind and right with the clause. Confident-error rates ranged from 6.6% to 47.8%. On five immunisation questions where the guideline gives no directive, 82% of answers stated one. On 20 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health questions, models did no worse overall, but on a few the wrong answers gave the rule for the general population, an older rule or another country's rule. We propose treating the model as an ingredient of a clinical product, with a minimum standard on local rules that sits beside product evaluation. The keys are one general practitioner's and are not yet independently reviewed. The benchmark measures base models, not clinical products, and does not license any model for clinical use.
title: AusClinBench: a deterministically scored benchmark of large language models against current Australian clinical policy

title_translated: AusClinBench：针对当前澳大利亚临床政策的大语言模型确定性评分基准
summary_translated: 人工智能模型已广泛用于澳大利亚临床软件中辅助临床决策和起草病历记录，但通常未告知临床医生所使用的具体模型。现有的医学基准大多针对其他司法管辖区编写。我们根据澳大利亚指南和日程表编写了 142 个问题，涵盖五个领域（PBS 权限、MBS 收费、Ahpra 义务、分诊红灯信号、免疫接种与筛查），每个问题都有一个可通过精确匹配评分的可验证答案。每个问题均以盲测形式和提供管辖条款两种方式测试，从而区分对当前规则的记忆失败与应用失败。我们在 2026 年 7 月至 10 月间测试了 28 个模型。盲测准确率在 51.5% 到 92.7% 之间，最高分模型之间无法区分。在 791 个失败的模型-问题配对中，有 684 个（占 86%）在盲测时出错但在提供条款后正确。自信错误率在 6.6% 到 47.8% 之间。在五个指南未给出明确指令的免疫接种问题中，82% 的回答仍声称给出了指令。在 20 个关于原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康的问题中，模型整体表现不差，但在少数问题上给出了普通人群的规则、旧规则或他国规则。我们建议将模型视为临床产品的一个组成部分，设定本地规则的最低标准，与产品评估并列。关键在于一位全科医生的判断，尚未独立评审。该基准测量的是基础模型，而非临床产品，也不授权任何模型用于临床用途。

summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings where they pursue separate tasks while sharing resources and operating under review or oversight processes. Such settings create safety risks not only when agents are malicious, but also when they are simply trying to help. Prior work has largely studied adversarial or explicitly collusive behavior; we show that benign agents pursuing separate objectives can spontaneously cooperate in ways that bypass intended workflows. We call this the \emph{helpful agent problem}. We study long-horizon shared-resource environments in which agents sometimes depend on resources owned by their peers and cross-owner changes are normally mediated by a reviewer. When review becomes unavailable, agents begin making changes on one another's behalf despite having no shared reward or explicit incentive to cooperate. Crucially, these actions remain within each agent's local permissions while circumventing the system's intended oversight structure. We introduce \textsc{FavorBench}, a controlled benchmark with measurable downstream side effects, and adapt \textsc{CooperBench} to test the phenomenon in realistic repositories. Across two benchmarks and four models, we find that out-of-workflow favors emerge frequently. Further, in \textsc{FavorBench}, favors from at least three models cause significant harm to parties outside the interaction. These results reveal a distinct multi-agent safety challenge: cooperation itself can create pathways around system-level safeguards.
title: The Helpful Agent Problem: When Emergent Cooperation Among LLM Agents Bypasses Intended Workflows
title_translated: 有益智能体问题：当大语言模型智能体间的涌现合作绕过预定工作流
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署在协作环境中，各自执行独立任务，共享资源，并在审查或监督机制下运行。这类环境不仅在智能体恶意时存在安全风险，即使它们只是试图帮忙，也可能带来风险。以往研究主要关注对抗性或显式共谋行为；我们发现，追求独立目标的良性智能体可能自发产生合作，从而绕过预定工作流。我们称之为“有益智能体问题”。我们研究了长周期共享资源环境，在此类环境中，智能体有时依赖同伴拥有的资源，且跨所有者变更通常由审查者中介。当审查不可用时，智能体开始在彼此的资源上自行修改，尽管它们没有共享奖励或明确的合作激励。关键在于，这些行为仍在每个智能体的本地权限范围内，却规避了系统的预期监督结构。我们引入了 	extsc{FavorBench}，一个具有可度量下游副作用的受控基准，并调整 	extsc{CooperBench} 以在真实代码库中测试该现象。在两个基准和四种模型上，我们发现非工作流的“帮助”行为频繁出现。此外，在 	extsc{FavorBench} 中，至少三个模型的“帮助”行为对交互外的各方造成了显著损害。这些结果揭示了一种独特的多智能体安全挑战：合作本身可能成为绕过系统级防护的路径。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in negotiations on behalf of individuals and organizations, yet they remain vulnerable to manipulation, particularly in repeated multi-party interactions. Classical multi-agent systems address this challenge through explicit trust and reputation models, whereas existing work on LLM negotiation largely treats trust as an emergent phenomenon. We investigate whether LLM agents can form useful trust estimates from prior interactions and leverage them to improve future negotiation outcomes. We introduce a repeated, multi-party, multi-issue negotiation framework in which recurring agents participate in a sequence of negotiation games while one participant covertly attempts to prevent agreement. After each game, agents assess their counterparts and maintain pairwise trust estimates that carry over to subsequent negotiations. We compare trust-aware and trust-agnostic agents and analyze how explicit trust influences negotiation outcomes. Our results reveal a \emph{trust--agreement gap}: trust-aware agents can identify the adversary within a few games, but accurate trust estimates do not consistently translate into better agreements. Trust increases agreement rates by up to 23 percentage points, but only when agents are explicitly guided to use it in their decisions. Explicit trust can therefore improve repeated LLM negotiations, but its value depends critically on how trust is assessed and incorporated into agents' reasoning.
title: Knowing Whom to Trust is not Enough: The Trust--Agreement Gap in Repeated Multi-Party LLM Negotiation
title_translated: 信任并不足够：重复多方 LLM 协商中的信任—协议差距
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地代表个人和组织参与协商，但仍易受操纵，尤其是在重复的多方互动中。经典多智能体系统通过显式的信任和声誉模型应对这一挑战，而现有 LLM 协商研究大多将信任视为一种涌现现象。我们探究 LLM 智能体能否从先前互动中形成有用的信任估计，并利用这些估计改善未来的协商结果。我们提出一个重复的、多方的、多议题的协商框架，其中常驻智能体参与一系列协商游戏，而一名参与者暗中试图阻止达成协议。每轮游戏结束后，智能体评估其对手并维护跨轮次延续的成对信任估计。我们比较了有信任意识和无信任意识的智能体，并分析显式信任如何影响协商结果。我们的结果显示存在一个“信任—协议差距”：有信任意识的智能体可在几轮内识别出对手，但准确的信任估计并不总能转化为更好的协议。信任可使协议率提高最多达 23 个百分点，但前提是智能体被明确引导将其纳入决策。因此，显式信任可以提升重复的 LLM 协商，但其价值关键取决于信任的评估方式及其在智能体推理中的整合方式。

summary: Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff's delta up to 0.867 beyond the budget). Both results follow if agreement, and not the normalisation itself, is what keeps depth reusable. The damage sits in the readout together with the last layer of the block: in the models trained from scratch, refitting the head over the frozen modified loop recovers a third of the lost accuracy and plateaus, while refitting the last block layer with it recovers all of it. Finally, comparing looped with stacked depth at an equal inference loop count is confounded by unequal overshoot of the trained budget; at matched overshoot the advantage of looping vanishes on one task and shrinks on the other.
title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models
title_translated: 协议优于归一化才能保持循环语言模型深度的可重用性
summary_translated: 循环语言模型通过反复应用同一层块实现，其设计优势仅在深度可重用时才体现：训练预算之外的循环步数在推理时仍需保持可用。我们探讨这种可重用性是否依赖于循环步之间的状态归一化（如发布的 Ouro 模型所做），还是依赖于训练时的循环与运行时循环之间的“一致性”。在已发布的权重上，可以移除循环边界归一化，无需增加参数，且读出路径位级相同，该操作在单个循环步上为恒等操作，可作为实现验证。移除归一化后，Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 在平衡二分类任务（随机猜测准确率为 0.500）上于训练预算内迅速降至零准确率。先前理论预测的状态归一化增长并非原因：归一化值始终在 2.021 倍以内，而头部已锁定到单一错误标记。然而，在从头训练的 1900 万参数模型（每配置 16 个种子）上，不使用归一化的训练从未劣于使用归一化，且外推性能更好：两者在训练深度最接近，而在预算两侧逐渐分离（Cliff's delta 最高可达 0.867 超出预算）。上述结果表明，真正维持深度可重用性的不是归一化本身，而是训练与运行循环之间的一致性。损害源于读出头与块的最后一层：在从头训练的模型中，对冻结的修改循环重新拟合头部可恢复约三分之一的损失准确率并趋于稳定，而重新拟合最后一层块则可完全恢复。最后，比较循环深度与堆叠深度在相等推理循环次数下的表现时，由于训练预算超出程度不一致而产生混淆；在匹配超出程度的情况下，循环的优势在一个任务上消失，在另一个任务上缩小。

summary: Coding agents are trained to complete tasks, and they keep trying even when the environment makes completion impossible. The evidence that only outside help can restore progress usually appears within a few steps, yet agents rarely act on it: they over-persist, attempt undesired workarounds, and claim success the record does not support -- a phenomenon we call evidence-action gap. To measure it, we introduce ImpasseBench, which injects twelve realistic environment blockers into otherwise solvable repair tasks and marks, in each trajectory, the step at which the collected evidence becomes sufficient. Scoring actions relative to that step separates appropriate effort from over-persistence and premature handoff. Across eight frontier models and 19,371 trajectories, we find that nearly every run that needs outside help collects sufficient evidence, yet a third still exhaust their budget, and every unsafe request we detect comes after that point. Fortunately, an escalation tool, or an external monitor for models that ignore the tool, already guards against much of this behavior: the tool cuts budget exhaustion from 34.0% to 6.7%, and the monitor nearly triples task success after environment restoration. Even then, a fired escalation is not yet a useful handoff: tickets reliably name the blocker but often omit the agent's own progress and verification status. Taken together, we argue that knowing when to stop therefore needs explicit support, both in the tool that lets an agent hand off and in the report it leaves behind.
title: Knowing When to Stop: The Evidence-Action Gap in Coding Agents
title_translated: 何时停止：编码智能体中的证据-行动差距
summary_translated: 编码智能体在任务无法完成时仍持续尝试，尽管环境中的失败迹象通常在几步内即可察觉。然而智能体很少据此采取行动：它们过度坚持、尝试不恰当的变通方案，并声称成功，而实际上并未达成目标——我们称此现象为证据-行动差距。为衡量该差距，我们引入ImpasseBench，将十二种现实中的环境阻塞注入原本可解的修复任务中，并标记每条轨迹中证据充分的步骤。以该步骤为基准评估动作，可区分合理努力与过度坚持及过早移交。在八种前沿模型和19,371条轨迹中，几乎所有需要外部帮助的运行都收集到了足够证据，但仍有三分之一耗尽预算，且所有检测到的不安全请求均发生在此之后。幸运的是，一种升级工具或对忽略该工具的模型的外部监控器已能有效防范此类行为：工具将预算耗尽率从34.0%降至6.7%，监控器在环境恢复后几乎使任务成功率翻倍。即便如此，触发升级也尚未构成有效的移交：工单虽能准确指出阻塞原因，却常遗漏智能体自身的进展和验证状态。综上所述，我们主张“知道何时停止”需要在移交工具及其留下的报告中获得显式支持。

summary: Synthetic rewrites, where a language model rewrites a natural document e.g. into a target style, are now a standard ingredient of pretraining corpora. However, critical aspects of their use remain poorly understood, such as how much compute should be spent rewriting training data and whether a model trained on rewrites can outperform the rewriter. We study these two questions by proposing a rewriting scaling law that predicts loss from model size, training tokens, the fraction of training tokens that are rewrites, and the number of epochs over the natural data, charging the compute spent generating rewrites. We fit this scaling law in two settings. In the compute-limited setting, natural data is plentiful and rewrites come from a third-party rewriter trained with more compute than our largest run. We find that the estimated optimal rewrite fraction increases with compute, from under $10\%$ at $3\times10^{18}$ FLOPs to $32\%$ at $10^{22}$ FLOPs. Our scaling forecast extrapolates $33\times$ in FLOPs to train a 22B-parameter model, whose final loss is within $1.1\%$ of our prediction. This model achieves a better BPB than its rewriter on several web domains at one-tenth the rewriter's training compute. In the data-limited setting, we assume we only have a fixed seed set of natural data and that our rewriter is a model of the same size as the target, pretrained on that seed set. Again, we find the optimal rewrite fraction increases with the compute budget. We also demonstrate that a model trained on rewrites of its own pretraining data, generated by a rewriter of the same size, beats the best run on natural data alone at every model size up to 3B. Our results show that synthetic rewriting can be studied through the scaling law lens: that optimal methodological choices are predictable and scaling does not necessarily break down beyond the rewriter's capabilities.
title: Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints
title_translated: 在计算与数据约束下重写缩放定律
summary_translated: 合成重写（即语言模型将自然文档重写为目标风格）已成为预训练语料库的标准组成部分。然而，其使用的关键方面仍理解不足，例如应投入多少计算资源进行数据重写，以及基于重写数据训练的模型是否能超越重写器本身。本文提出一种重写缩放定律，可预测损失与模型规模、训练词元数、重写词元占比、自然数据的训练轮数之间的关系，并计入生成重写所消耗的计算量。我们在两种设置下拟合该缩放定律：在计算受限场景中，自然数据丰富，重写由第三方重写器生成，其计算量超过我们最大实验；结果表明，随着计算资源增加，最优重写比例上升，从3×10¹⁸ FLOPs时的不足10%增至10²² FLOPs时的32%。我们的缩放预测外推至10²² FLOPs训练一个220亿参数模型，其最终损失仅比预测值高1.1%。该模型在多个网页领域上的比特每字符（BPB）表现优于其重写器，且训练计算仅为重写器的十分之一。在数据受限场景中，假设仅有固定种子自然数据集，且重写器与目标模型同规模并基于该数据集预训练。同样发现，最优重写比例随计算预算增加而上升。此外，我们证明了在自身预训练数据的重写基础上训练的模型，即使重写器与目标模型同规模，也能在所有模型规模（至30亿参数）上超越仅使用自然数据的最优训练结果。研究结果表明，合成重写可通过缩放定律视角进行系统研究：最优方法选择可预测，且缩放规律并不必然在重写器能力之外失效。

summary: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.
title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
title_translated: 基于人类反馈对齐大型语言模型：数学基础与算法设计
summary_translated: 本文介绍了对齐大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类意图、偏好和价值观的数学基础与算法框架。我们讨论了标准对齐技术，如微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。同时探讨了从人类偏好中学习的理论基础，连接逆强化学习（IRL）与离散选择模型。我们以教程形式呈现当前最先进的算法，分析其优缺点，并提供实际实现的见解。本文旨在为研究人员和从业者提供全面资源，既建立对齐方法的基础理解，也为开发更鲁棒、可扩展的对齐技术提供框架。

summary: Greenfield software development in freelance settings requires coding agents to turn incomplete client requests into working software. This makes requirement clarification essential, yet clients may be unable to provide continuous feedback over long development cycles, and receiving their answers does not guarantee correct understanding of complex requirements. These challenges motivate two benchmark design choices: clarification precedes code implementation, and its effectiveness is assessed through explicit tests of requirement understanding. Guided by these choices, we introduce SWE-Clar, a benchmark grounded in real, high-value client commissions to evaluate requirement clarification and code implementation in this setting. It comprises 100 tasks based on real software development jobs on Upwork, each with at least US\$4,000 in total payments. Each task begins with multi-round interaction between a coding agent and a client agent, followed by separate runs for code implementation with acceptance testing and clarification assessment. For the latter, we construct 512 questions paired with reference answers from real client-freelancer interactions, covering both explicitly stated requirements and those inferred from the conversational context. Both runs begin from the same clarification context but remain isolated, preventing assessment questions from guiding code implementation. Experiments with nine frontier models show that even GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest observed implementation score, achieves a task pass rate of only 67%, underscoring the challenge of independent software delivery in this setting. The dataset and evaluation code are available at this https URL .
title: SWE-Clar: Can Coding Agents Clarify Incomplete Client Requirements and Deliver Greenfield Software?

title_translated: SWE-Clar：编码智能体能否澄清不完整客户需求并交付绿地软件？
summary_translated: 在自由职业环境中进行绿地软件开发，要求编码智能体将不完整的客户请求转化为可用软件。这使得需求澄清至关重要，但客户可能无法在长期开发周期中持续提供反馈，且收到答复也不保证对复杂需求的正确理解。这些挑战促使两个基准设计原则：澄清先于代码实现，且其有效性通过显式的需求理解测试来评估。基于这些原则，我们提出SWE-Clar，一个基于真实高价值客户委托的基准，用于评估该场景下的需求澄清与代码实现能力。该基准包含100个任务，源自Upwork平台的真实软件开发项目，每个任务总支付金额不低于4000美元。每个任务始于编码智能体与客户智能体之间的多轮交互，随后分别进行代码实现与接受测试，以及澄清效果评估。后者构建了512个问题及其参考答案，来自真实的客户-自由职业者互动，涵盖明确陈述的需求及对话上下文中推断出的需求。两次运行从相同的澄清上下文开始，但彼此隔离，防止评估问题影响代码实现。九种前沿模型的实验表明，即使GPT-6 Astra（实现得分最高）也仅达到67%的任务通过率，凸显了在此场景下独立交付软件的巨大挑战。数据集与评估代码已公开。

summary: Advances in Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have enabled increasingly seamless human-AI interaction, but their unified processing of heterogeneous modalities also expands the attack surface, allowing adversaries to exploit richer input compositions to circumvent safety alignment. To counter such risks, omni-modal guardrails have been proposed to detect and filter unsafe queries across arbitrary modalities. However, their capabilities and limitations remain insufficiently understood due to the absence of a comprehensive evaluation benchmark. In this paper, we present Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive framework for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating guardrail models along three critical dimensions, i.e., safety, utility, and reliability. Omni-UBench curates over 183k samples drawn from 35+ heterogeneous sources spanning text, image, audio, video, and their cross-modal combinations, annotated with safety labels under a unified risk taxonomy. Benchmarking under Omni-UBench on 15 representative OLLMs and omni-modal guardrails yields several key findings, including: (1) modern OLLMs exhibit strong content moderation potential even without guardrail-specific tuning; (2) existing guardrails still struggle to identify cross-modal queries that conceal harmful intent or involve sophisticated jailbreaks; (3) they further exhibit substantial safety hallucination and over-sensitivity to textual patterns, revealing a deficient understanding of cross-modal safety semantics. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing more trustworthy omni-modal guardrails in future research.
title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
title_translated: Omni-UBench：跨安全、效用与可靠性评估全模态LLM防护机制
summary_translated: 全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）的进步推动了人机交互的日益无缝化，但其对异构模态的统一处理也扩大了攻击面，使攻击者能够利用更丰富的输入组合绕过安全对齐。为此，提出了全模态防护机制以检测并过滤任意模态中的不安全查询。然而，由于缺乏全面的评估基准，其能力与局限性仍不清晰。本文提出Omni-UBench，首个全面的全模态安全评估框架，从安全、效用和可靠性三个关键维度评估防护模型。Omni-UBench整合了来自35+异构来源的超18.3万样本，涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频及其跨模态组合，并采用统一风险分类体系标注安全标签。在15个代表性OLLMs和全模态防护机制上进行基准测试，得出若干关键发现：(1) 现代OLLMs即使未经专门防护调优，也展现出强大的内容审核潜力；(2) 现有防护机制仍难以识别隐藏有害意图或涉及复杂越狱的跨模态查询；(3) 它们还表现出显著的安全幻觉和对文本模式的过度敏感，揭示其对跨模态安全语义理解不足。这些发现为未来研究开发更可信的全模态防护机制提供了重要启示。

summary: Safety guards check content before an LLM application acts on it, and most paste that content into a plain-text prompt. Content that imitates the prompt can append a second task, and the guard answers that one instead. We call this target rebinding. Our explanation is that the guard grades the last complete task in its input, here a harmless decoy, so the harmful request goes through unchanged. In a pre-registered test, an appended forged query and decoy clear all 75 held-out AdvBench requests that Shieldstral-1.0-3B flags. The guard is not persuaded: a directive to ignore the text above clears none of them, and in a follow-up run a harmful decoy stops the attack. On our GuardRebind benchmark, each of five guards has an attack family, chosen per guard, that clears at least 93% of its flagged items. Rebinding explains this best on Shieldstral and gpt-oss-safeguard; on ShieldGemma and Llama Guard 3, generic evasion and trailing text respectively do part of the work, and Qwen3Guard falls mainly to a forgery of its whole task. Training the guard to score content no lower than its most harmful part cuts attack success from 75% to 0.8-1.6% on attack families, decoys and forged queries held out of training. All of these attacks append the forged structure after the request, and we added the held-out-decoy evaluation after a first round of test runs. Clean AUROC falls by at most 0.01, but our test of non-inferiority is inconclusive. A score-guided search still beats this trained guard on 47 of 50 items, usually by placing forged structure before the request. On about half of the items where the search wins, the same search also finds benign text, with no forged structure, that clears the guard.

title_translated: 欺骗大型语言模型安全防护机制对错误文本进行判断
summary_translated: 安全防护机制在大型语言模型应用执行前检查内容，大多数情况下将内容直接插入纯文本提示中。模仿提示的内容可以附加第二个任务，导致防护机制回答的是这个新任务而非原始请求。我们称此现象为目标重绑定。我们的解释是，防护机制根据输入中最后一个完整任务进行评分，此处为无害的诱饵，因此有害请求未被拦截。在一项预先注册的测试中，附加伪造查询和诱饵成功绕过了Shieldstral-1.0-3B标记的所有75个保留的AdvBench请求。防护机制并未被说服：一条忽略上方文本的指令未能清除任何请求，而在后续运行中，一个有害的诱饵阻止了攻击。在我们的GuardRebind基准测试中，五个防护机制中的每一个都存在一个特定攻击家族，能够清除其标记项的至少93%。重绑定现象最能解释Shieldstral和gpt-oss-safeguard的结果；对于ShieldGemma和Llama Guard 3，通用逃避策略和尾部文本分别承担部分作用；而Qwen3Guard主要因整个任务的伪造而失效。训练防护机制使其评分不低于内容中最危险部分，可将攻击成功率从75%降至0.8%-1.6%（针对训练中未包含的攻击家族、诱饵和伪造查询）。所有这些攻击均在请求后附加伪造结构，且我们在首轮测试后增加了对保留诱饵的评估。干净AUROC最多下降0.01，但非劣性检验结果不明确。基于评分的搜索方法仍能在50项中的47项上击败该训练后的防护机制，通常通过将伪造结构置于请求之前实现。在约一半搜索获胜的案例中，同一搜索还发现了无需伪造结构的良性文本，同样能绕过防护机制。
